Just as there are saints who will spread and glorify the profound gospel, there are envoys who must correct any twisted strains and remove any dissonance.
People often say that steel feels like ice as it pierces the body, but this dark frost is said to freeze even the soul.
affixes: 剧情任务-脱战逻辑标签
咏者使徒通用爬塔开盾前挣脱词缀

monster_meta.json.name: Abyss Lector: Violet Lightning
monster_meta.json.title: Evangelist of Striking Thunder
monster_meta.json.description:
A monster who serves the Abyss Order and commands lightning while singing the praises of the darkness.
These are the evangelists and the scholars of the Abyss. Their violent lightning strikes the hearts of unbelievers with dark wisdom, warped by the shadowy depths of an eternal night, its violet glow proclaiming the existence of a great power that corrodes human intellect.
affixes: 咏者使徒通用爬塔开盾前挣脱词缀

monster_meta.json.name: Abyss Lector: Fathomless Flames
monster_meta.json.title: The Devouring Benthic Flame
monster_meta.json.description:
Wielders of abyssal fire who pursue the meaning behind texts and scriptures. Is a member of the Abyss Order.
The surface people have a slightly distorted understanding of what their name means, calling them "Lectors," when their name can also mean "exegete." Reading the word of grace grants them great power.
affixes: 咏者使徒通用爬塔开盾前挣脱词缀

monster_meta.json.name: Rockfond Rifthound Whelp
monster_meta.json.title: Rifthound Whelp
monster_meta.json.description:
A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. "Gold" classified them as "Alfisol."
They follow the encroaching abyss to devour the elements. Fortunately, there are few of them left now in this world.

monster_meta.json.name: Thundercraven Rifthound Whelp
monster_meta.json.title: Rifthound Whelp
monster_meta.json.description:
A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. "Gold" classified them as "Alfisol."
In times long gone, when giant monstrous beasts descended, large swarms of these hounds would go before them to deliquesce the borders of the world and open the way.

monster_meta.json.name: Rockfond Rifthound
monster_meta.json.title: Rifthound
monster_meta.json.description:
A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. They were created by "Gold."
They do display certain biological behaviors similar to those of real wolves. Perhaps they feel jealousy towards these their "next of kin," and dream of replacing them someday.

monster_meta.json.name: Thundercraven Rifthound
monster_meta.json.title: Rifthound
monster_meta.json.description:
A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. They were created by "Gold."
Once upon a time, they ran riot across the continent, but they went extinct for a time due to resistance and mass hunts. Recently, however, they have re-emerged. The pack of black wolves that now threaten Springvale and Wolvendom are such creatures.

monster_meta.json.name: Golden Wolflord
monster_meta.json.title: Golden Wolflord
monster_meta.json.description:
Hailing from a dark world, this ruler of the black wolves has the power to call upon its followers, its hidden claws, to dissolve space itself and forge a rift through which it may enter.
The Wolflord has no name, for it was but one of "Gold"'s unintentional creations, and that is precisely why it is obsessed with invading worlds that do not belong to it and making a name for itself.
That said, the wolf pack is far from unintelligent. After suffering a defeat in its previous invasion, a deserted island where no humans or protectors dwell has been selected for them to prepare for their lord's descent.

monster_meta.json.name: Shadowy Husk: Standard Bearer
monster_meta.json.title: The Black Serpent Knights' End
monster_meta.json.description:
A pitch-dark soldier. Once a proud warrior of an ancient underground nation, it has now lost any awareness of memory.
But even so, it holds the banner of the royal house aloft into battle. Though it has forgotten its comrades or any royal blessing they might have been given, it will never lay this banner down.

monster_meta.json.name: Shadowy Husk: Line Breaker
monster_meta.json.title: The Black Serpent Knights' End
monster_meta.json.description:
A pitch-dark soldier. Once a proud warrior of an ancient underground nation, it no longer has any "intelligence" that it may still be called "human."
Yet the desire to destroy the foe and plunge into battle to defend others is etched into this empty suit of armor, even if no one remains to tell it where the enemy is or who or what exactly must be defended.

monster_meta.json.name: Shadowy Husk: Defender
monster_meta.json.title: The Black Serpent Knights' End
monster_meta.json.description:
A pitch-dark soldier. Once a proud warrior of an ancient underground nation, it is now nothing but a husk that only bears memories of battle.
All shall decay in the end, and this is all that is left of the Black Serpent Knights amidst the merciless march of their sins, curses, and time itself.

monster_meta.json.name: Black Serpent Knight: Windcutter
monster_meta.json.title: "Once Upon a Gentle Wind..."
monster_meta.json.description:
A guard of some standing in the court, sundering the foes of the nation's rulers using a sword art known as "Truthseeker."
The Twilight Sword was once one of their number. That realm's glory has been extinguished, never again to be reclaimed.

monster_meta.json.name: Black Serpent Knight: Rockbreaker Ax
monster_meta.json.title: "Once Stood Against the Tide of Dark Waters Like Bedrock..."
monster_meta.json.description:
A guard of some standing in the court, sundering the foes of the nation's rulers using a sword art known as "Truthseeker."
Though Truthseeker is, strictly speaking, a sword art, its teachings can also be used with various other weapons — and in the realm's darkest hour, those who had to protect their homeland had little room to be fussy anyway.

monster_meta.json.name: Iniquitous Baptist
monster_meta.json.title: Iniquitous Baptist
monster_meta.json.description: A monster from the Abyss that wields multiple types of Elemental Power and has gained extra limbs from its "evolution." "The nature of the 'Abyss' is essentially irreconcilable with the elements. However, even the elements of gods can be entrapped and distorted before they are subsumed to become tools of the abyssal will. Just judging from outcomes and practical use, "Abyssal powers" seem little different from elemental items, from ones as paltry as the Treasure Hoarders' elemental containers to those as powerful as Visions..." —Notes left behind in Hangeh Afrasiyab by someone.

monster_meta.json.name: Large Shatterstone Breacher Primus
monster_meta.json.title: Large Shatterstone Breacher Primus
monster_meta.json.description:
A strange life form that mostly appears in Elynas.
Melusines perceive Breacher Primuses as harmless creatures, and many even find them completely adorable.
The visual perception of Melusines is very different from humans.

monster_meta.json.name: Shatterstone Breacher Primus
monster_meta.json.title: Shatterstone Breacher Primus
monster_meta.json.description:
A strange life form that mostly appears in Elynas.
Receives a powerful shock from encountering ousia or pneuma energy, and thus Breacher Primuses can be driven away using this relatively nonaggressive and noninvasive means.

monster_meta.json.name: Large Overgrown Breacher Primus
monster_meta.json.title: Large Overgrown Breacher Primus
monster_meta.json.description:
A strange life form that mostly appears in Elynas.
The nature of a Breacher Primus defies known categories: they are not animals, plants, Shroom-Kin, nor Elementals. The debate among scholars of Sumeru never formally reached a consensus on just what it is, until it was finally banned as a research topic. The reason is that based on the current system of knowledge, this problem is like "the definitions prescribed by language and the true nature of things," and it is impossible to have a meaningful, final answer.

monster_meta.json.name: Tenebrous Papilla: Type I
monster_meta.json.title: Tenebrous Papilla
monster_meta.json.description:
Abyssal creatures with plant-like forms that have descended from a deep, dark, unfathomable, contorted otherworld.
These twisted monstrosities are capable of infiltrating deep down into the bowels of the earth, extracting memories to imitate and manipulate. Through this process of distorting the past's memories into more abstruse and sordid forms, they gradually draw closer to Irminsul's core, threatening to undermine its very existence.
Some say that these aberrations work constantly to corrupt the many colors of light, leaving only pitch-black information in their stead. Such a hypothesis seems to be confirmed by the branches they extend outward, as if to pierce the void itself...
affixes: 所有怪物使用深渊次数盾必须挂载

monster_meta.json.name: Tenebrous Mimiflora
monster_meta.json.title: Tenebrous Mimiflora
monster_meta.json.description:
Abyssal monsters that have descended to this world from the deep, dark depths of a twisted and alien world, they possess a plant-like appearance.
It is said that where the corrosive waves of the dark tide lap, such plant-like dark monsters will grow. But they only bear a superficial resemblance to plants, for it is a form they only adopted to get closer to the tree-like world, that they might extract the necessary concepts from it, and analyze and imitate them.
Some raving lunatics who have lost their minds say that those things that extend out like leaves are actually the beginnings of gates to other worlds.

monster_meta.json.name: Wilderness Exile
monster_meta.json.title: Shadow of the Wild Hunt
monster_meta.json.description:
A ghoul that stalks the frozen wilderness when the pitch-dark mist rolls in. Their emergence presages worse calamities to come.
All who dwell beneath the moon set out on journeys with their own goals and wishes in mind, but not all such wishes receive favor. Spirits that cannot rest due to engendered resentment, partings with loved ones, or desires that go unfulfilled, if corrupted by the Abyss, may transform into ghouls, forever lost in the thick mists of the Wild Hunt.

monster_meta.json.name: Wilderness Hunter
monster_meta.json.title: Shadow of the Wild Hunt
monster_meta.json.description:
A ghoul that stalks the frozen wilderness when the pitch-dark mist rolls in. Their emergence presages worse calamities to come.
Many great champions of a lost ancient kingdom lie buried beneath the frozen northlands. Though the remnants of the past have been long wiped clean, these noble spirits yet defend their golden homeland. Awakened by Abyssal taint, these warriors now see all who trespass as prey.

monster_meta.json.name: Fisher of Hidden Depths
monster_meta.json.title: Eyrie Beast of Another World
monster_meta.json.description:
An Abyssal creature that slips through rifts in the hidden depths, crossing over from beyond this world.
Long ago, an ancient philosopher described humans as "featherless bipeds," using that simple phrase to distinguish mankind from animals and assert human superiority. In some sense, these deathless wanderers of the silent cosmic void, scaled instead of feathered, and using their hooked beaks to draw in biomass from world to world, might actually also match that same simplistic definition of "human."

monster_meta.json.name: Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares
monster_meta.json.title: Faceless, Boundless Overlord
monster_meta.json.description:
An Abyssal creature that creeps through rifts in the hidden depths, quietly watching this world. Its eerie, faceless form is said to be nothing more than a projection, for its true body exists only as a formless mass of pure Abyssal energy.
Even invaders who seek to claim this world must obey its rules to some extent. Unless the heavens split open and the earth's defenses collapse, these star-born outsiders can do little more than linger at the world's fringes, whispering their madness into this realm, their attempts to seep inside amounting to nothing... But how long can this stability and order truly last?

monster_meta.json.name: Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire
monster_meta.json.title: Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire
monster_meta.json.description:
A soldier encased within a Fatui war machine.
Armed with equipment that can control the elements to a certain extent, their guns are capable of firing jets of frost.
Though this may confer elemental power beyond the ken of ordinary humans, that power may yet come at a price...

monster_meta.json.name: Fatui Skirmisher - Hydrogunner Legionnaire
monster_meta.json.title: Fatui Skirmisher - Hydrogunner Legionnaire
monster_meta.json.description:
A soldier encased within a Fatui war machine.
Armed with equipment that can control the elements to a certain extent, their guns are capable of firing jets of water.
These skirmishers do not question if they shall live or die as they advance into nations far from home to complete reconnaissance missions and lay the groundwork for operations to come.

monster_meta.json.name: Fatui Skirmisher - Electrohammer Vanguard
monster_meta.json.title: Fatui Skirmisher - Electrohammer Vanguard
monster_meta.json.description:
A sturdily-built skirmisher armed with an Electro-powered war-hammer.
As a Fatui soldier, one has access to munificent resources: salaries, armaments, and supplies.
But at the same time, it also means much time away from home and family and putting one's life in the hands of comrades one has never met.

monster_meta.json.name: Fatui Skirmisher - Geochanter Bracer
monster_meta.json.title: Fatui Skirmisher - Geochanter Bracer
monster_meta.json.description:
A skirmisher with the ability to generate a Geo Ward and defend their allies.
Unlike the elite Mages and Agents, Fatui Skirmishers are soldiers of lesser individual might.
To complete their tasks and reduce losses in men and material, their tactics are thus more reliant on teamwork.

monster_meta.json.name: Fatui Skirmisher - Anemoboxer Vanguard
monster_meta.json.title: Fatui Skirmisher - Anemoboxer Vanguard
monster_meta.json.description:
A skirmisher armed with the ability to manipulate Anemo and heal their comrades.
They departed from their motherland and did so for its sake. They left their family, yet gained allies to stick through thick and thin with.
—Perhaps such thoughts are what get them through the unscrupulous work that their missions entail.

monster_meta.json.name: Fatui Skirmisher - Pyroslinger Bracer
monster_meta.json.title: Fatui Skirmisher - Pyroslinger Bracer
monster_meta.json.description:
A Fatui soldier who wields a flaming gun.
Skirmisher weapons can control the elements to a certain extent, and their combat tactics utilize elemental reactions.
Their ordnance and knowledge of squad-based combat thus constitute no small threat in battle.

monster_meta.json.name: Fatui Pyro Agent
monster_meta.json.title: Agent - Incinerating Blades
monster_meta.json.description:
A Fatui secret agent.
The duty of a Fatui agent is to settle debts — but not only those of a monetary or goods-in-kind nature.
They also ensure dues are paid when it comes to the principle of "an eye for an eye." If there is one thing the Fatui are not known for, it is leniency, and whoever dares to oppose them will invoke the full force of their wrath.

monster_meta.json.name: Veteran Fatui Pyro Agent
monster_meta.json.title: Agent - Incinerating Blades
affixes: 精英化词缀-详见对应文档

monster_meta.json.name: Fatui Electro Cicin Mage
monster_meta.json.title: Cicin Mage - Thunder Embracer
monster_meta.json.description:
A Fatui mage who can command Electro Cicins in battle. Their origins and what they look like under that mask are both mysteries.
Similarly to the way that Electro Cicins go crazy for Mist Grass, Cicin Mages take great pleasure in toying with their prey.
affixes: 召唤怪跟随创建者的生命周期

monster_meta.json.name: Fatui Cryo Cicin Mage
monster_meta.json.title: Cicin Mage: Hoarfrost Wielder
monster_meta.json.description:
A Fatui mage who can command Cryo Cicins in battle. Their origins and what they look like under that mask are both mysteries.
Reason dictates that those who lack Visions should not be able to control the elements as these mages do. However, in addition to using Mist Grass to control the Cryo Cicins, they also boldly wield the might of frost. Seeing them as they wander the land in their seemingly aimless way, one can't help but wonder about the duty that must compel them...
affixes: 召唤怪跟随创建者的生命周期

monster_meta.json.name: Mirror Maiden
monster_meta.json.title: Snezhnayan Maiden: Mirror Envoy
monster_meta.json.description:
A Fatui mage who can command a Hydro Mirror in battle. Her posture is highly dignified, as if she is one who worships a god.
The Hydro Mirror she manipulates lures those enchanted by her to willingly fall for her illusion. Nothing seems to escape her ears. No one knows what those covered eyes have seen, nor what kind of obsession might be reflected in them...

monster_meta.json.name: Frost Operative
monster_meta.json.title: Rimesword Servant
monster_meta.json.description:
An elite agent among the Fatui.
Selected while still children, they can only become an "Operative" after many long years of training and teaching, after countless rounds have winnowed the field. They are the most outstanding soldiers among the Fatui, with extraordinary skill and unswerving loyalty.

monster_meta.json.name: Wind Operative
monster_meta.json.title: Gale-Lily Servant
monster_meta.json.description:
An elite agent among the Fatui.
"Operatives" have no ordinary military rank among the Fatui. Based on their orders and the content of their missions, they can work in concert with other soldiers, work alone, or in tandem with the "tacks" hidden and scattered across the world. They spy, conduct counter-espionage, protect, assassinate, and conduct other tasks. In order to effectively carry out missions of a more special nature, "Operatives" also need to master all kinds of other skills and even various arts and talents.

monster_meta.json.name: Oprichniki Line Trooper
monster_meta.json.title: Oprichniki
monster_meta.json.description:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a gunblade and tasked to hold the line as the resilient backbone of the Oprichniki forces.
According to Snezhnayan infantry manuals, the primary duties of line troops are merely to aim, shoot, and charge. Even should the individual soldier's combat power not prove exceptional, soldiers of the line in tight formation remain a key foundation of the Snezhnayan military machine.

monster_meta.json.name: Oprichniki Engineer
monster_meta.json.title: Oprichniki
affixes: TPS-通用词缀-受击叠加限制0.2幅度

monster_meta.json.name: Oprichniki Support Trooper
monster_meta.json.title: Oprichniki
monster_meta.json.description:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a heavy shield and tasked to fight at the very front to protect their comrades.
Many understand that in the long war between Snezhnaya and the dark calamity, only the side that holds out with greater resolution can outlast the other and emerge victorious. The ultimate resolution of the Oprichniki is, undoubtedly, the shield that protects their forces — so long as this shield does not fall, there is always hope for victory.

monster_meta.json.name: Oprichniki Grenadier
monster_meta.json.title: Oprichniki
monster_meta.json.description:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a man-portable grenade launcher that can perform close-range bombardment.
Though the Oprichniki has large-scale, fully-functional fire support attachments, the commanding staff still advocates for large numbers of grenadiers to be maintained. After all, no big gun can compare in surety at the very front lines of combat to a grenade launcher you can direct at will.

monster_meta.json.name: Oprichniki Vanguard
monster_meta.json.title: Oprichniki
monster_meta.json.description:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with engineering tools and highly adept in close-range combat.
To meet the demands of battlefield operations, the Fatui Oprichniki established vanguard units, tasked with clearing the path of obstacles for advancing forces. As for exactly what counts as an obstacle, that hardly matters. Be it an impassable ravine or a formidable foe standing in their way, they will remove it without hesitation — whatever it takes to ensure the banner of the Pale Star marches on.

monster_meta.json.name: Oprichniki Medic
monster_meta.json.title: Oprichniki
monster_meta.json.description:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a staff-like device and tasked with providing emergency medical support to their comrades in arms.
In truth, these medics have largely only taken crash-course training, and as such, their healing abilities are limited. In practice, they tend to adopt more efficient methods of supporting their allies — mixing in with the different units and charging at the enemy lines.

monster_meta.json.name: Oprichniki Bombardier
monster_meta.json.title: Oprichniki
monster_meta.json.description:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a specialized hover pack and explosive charges, and tasked with performing breaching operations.
As troops with immense breakthrough potential, bombardiers are often sent to the most dire of battlefields, making them the troops who gain meritorious promotions most quickly. It is said that Oprichniki officers overwhelmingly come from the ranks of the bombardiers.

monster_meta.json.name: Oprichniki Fireblade Shock Trooper
monster_meta.json.title: Oprichniki Fireblade Shock Trooper
monster_meta.json.description:
An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who specializes in close combat using a giant blade.
Whether it be in the war against the dark calamity or against those ignoramuses who dare stand against the Tsaritsa's ideals, those who breach at the tip of the spear suffer the greatest casualties. As such, those who survive multiple battles are naturally the elite of the elite. There will always be those willing to become the fire and sword of the empire, just as there will always be those who chafe against the injustice of fate and the inequity of the Old World.

monster_meta.json.name: Oprichniki Hailstorm Cannoneer
monster_meta.json.title: Oprichniki
monster_meta.json.description:
An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who uses a heavy cannon to tear enemy formations apart while using a mighty shield to defend their comrades.
Bitter battles have dyed the shield frost white, while coatings of blood have tinted its edges black. Oprichniki officers know that empty words will never bring back those who have fallen in sacrifice — only a bombardment akin to a hailstorm can shake this defiled Old World.

monster_meta.json.name: Oprichniki Thunderblitz Gvardiya
monster_meta.json.title: Oprichniki
monster_meta.json.description:
An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who specializes in using twin guns in combat.
Unlike their Skirmisher cousins, Oprichniki officers almost all hail from the Snezhnayan Royal Military Academy, whether due to the privilege of noble birth or the rare talent to escape a common background. After all, neither is truly different from the other within the Tsaritsa's beneficent, loving ideals. Traditionally, only fae could become elite Gvardiya, but today, this glorious role and title has been given to Oprichniki officers — a more equal division for the construction of a new world.

monster_meta.json.name: Close Combat Scout Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.title: Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.description:
An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land."
These walking Landcruisers with bipedal structures are often used as "scouts," for they are able to quickly traverse rough terrain and reach key positions to seize the initiative for their allies. Their close-combat-oriented rotating blades allow them to deal fatal damage to their foes and shred shrubbery and obstacles to open the way, allowing units to operate with ease even amidst thick vegetation.

monster_meta.json.name: Force Recon Storm Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.title: Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.description:
An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land."
Equipped with Crawler Track Movement Mechanisms, these Landcruisers are normally used to storm enemy positions, where they can pass over rough terrain such as mud and melting snow despite heavy armor and armaments through their excellent load-bearing capabilities and off-road mobility. Force Recon armaments include a multi-barrel automatic gun, allowing this Landcruiser to adjust its tactics to both close quarters and long-range combat. Whether it be long-range observation or obtaining enemy intel in the midst of fearsome firefights, this Landcruiser model is more than up to the task.

monster_meta.json.name: Force Recon Scout Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.title: Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.description:
An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land."
These walking Landcruisers with bipedal structures are often used as "scouts," for they are able to quickly traverse rough terrain and reach key positions to seize the initiative for their allies. Equipped with Force Recon armaments, this Landcruiser can not only serve as a forward scout for the main force, but can also exploit openings and actively attack the enemy where their lines are weakest, thus playing a similar role to that of traditional cavalry...

monster_meta.json.name: Force Recon Ground Effect Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.title: Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.description:
An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land."
The ground effect Landcruiser is able to "fly" a certain distance above ground by maintaining lift and generating pressure differentials through firing high-speed jet sprays at the surface, allowing it to more economically achieve combat cruising speed, avoid mines and traps, and perform highly effective assaults. However, costs and limits on operation time mean that mass-produced models carry limited payloads. As such, they are currently limited to Force Recon roles...

monster_meta.json.name: Cutting Edge All-Purpose Storm Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.title: Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.description:
Balancing cutting-edge tech, production costs, and sortie rates, these elite Landcruisers confer immense penetrative power upon any order of battle, and are the key fulcrum of the frontline.
The all-purpose storm combat package combines multi-barrel automatic guns with close-quarter rotating blades, allowing this Landcruiser to battle opponents at any range, while heavy howitzers on both arms allow it to obliterate cover and deny defenders the benefit of their fortifications. According to combat doctrine co-authored by the Fatui and the Royal Military Academy, these Landcruisers must be supported by all nearby units when they attack, speedily punching a hole in enemy lines, which will allow for follow-up attacks in depth that will then cause the enemy defenses to collapse completely.

monster_meta.json.name: Cutting Edge All-Purpose Scout Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.title: Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.description:
Balancing cutting-edge tech, production costs, and sortie rates, these elite Landcruisers confer immense penetrative power upon any order of battle, and are the key fulcrum of the frontline.
The all-purpose scout combat package is designed for both long- and short-range combat, and not only leads scout Landcruiser squads, but also provides close support for All-Purpose Storm Landcruisers during high-intensity battles, such as crossing specialized anti-Landcruiser trenches, or destroying enemy strongpoints. This Landcruiser type can also keep up with the tip of the spear as it breaks through in depth, before swinging out to the wings and swiftly attacking key targets in the enemy's rear lines.

monster_meta.json.name: Cutting Edge Fire Support Ground Effect Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.title: Landcruiser
monster_meta.json.description:
Balancing cutting-edge tech, production costs, and sortie rates, these elite Landcruisers confer immense penetrative power upon any order of battle, and are the key fulcrum of the frontline.
After being equipped with high-efficiency jet engines, this Ground Effect Landcruiser has gained the ability to carry multiple armaments, allowing it to deliver this sizable firepower anywhere on the battlefield in a timely fashion. As such, the combat doctrine co-authored by the Fatui and the Royal Military Academy states that they are to be organized as a "Quick Reaction Force" in large-scale battles, meant to guard against enemy breakthroughs or counterattacks, and to press the advantage if the battle is going favorably. Of course, all such Landcruisers have the ability to operate independently, and on long tours of duty, they can form the core of a small squad and thus maximize the firepower of various Fatui unit types...

monster_meta.json.name: Super-Heavy Landrover: Mechanized Fortress
monster_meta.json.title: Super-Heavy Landrover: Mechanized Fortress
monster_meta.json.description:
Referred to internally as the "Type Drzislav," this super heavy-class mechanism was jointly developed by the Armory Palace and the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau.
This giant all-terrain vehicle was originally designed for civilian use, particularly heavy transport, as evidenced by its equipped drills and cutters. However, later production models were militarized with heavy weapons mounted on them.
After all, in this mortal world beneath the moon, even the most perfect and divine designs may stray from their original intent, let alone machines born of mortal hands, crafted from humble intentions and flawed from the very beginning.

monster_meta.json.name: Ruin Guard
monster_meta.json.title: Ruin Guard
monster_meta.json.description:
An ancient humanoid war machine.
Legend has it that these machines were combat automatons created by a long-destroyed nation. They now wander ruins and ancient detritus, attacking offending travelers. Research indicates that the Ruin Guards and the ruins they operate in do not originate from the same source, suggesting that there may be a difference of as much as several thousand years between them on the timeline. So why then do the Ruin Guards continue staying among these ruins, using their "explosive firepower" to protect the crumbling walls and broken tiles?

monster_meta.json.name: Ruin Hunter
monster_meta.json.title: Ruin Hunter
monster_meta.json.description:
A giant alien-looking war machine.
They are said to be remnants from a lost ancient nation. It seems that the creators opted to forgo the low-performing humanoid-design in pursuit of improved combat effectiveness. They are extremely dangerous both in melee and ranged combat.
Considering these mere relics possess such extraordinary power, one cannot help but wonder what the civilization that produced them must have looked like at its height.

monster_meta.json.name: Ruin Grader
monster_meta.json.title: Ruin Grader
monster_meta.json.description:
An ancient humanoid war machine.
Their form is similar to that of Ruin Guards, but is more distorted and more powerful. Energy cores have been installed in both its legs, as though to power its overly heavy form.

monster_meta.json.name: Ruin Serpent
monster_meta.json.title: Ruin Serpent
monster_meta.json.description:
An ancient, bizarrely-shaped autonomous machine.
It is said that this was heavy-duty engineering equipment left behind by a nation that has been destroyed. The gear system on its "head" can grind its way through even the hardest bedrock. If this was the case, then carving out tunnels with which the forces of this nation might access the whole continent would have been a thing of great ease.

monster_meta.json.name: Ruin Cruiser
monster_meta.json.title: Ruin Cruiser
monster_meta.json.description:
Various bizarrely-shaped machines that have taken different forms and functions to adapt to different goals.
Legend has it that they are war machines left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Compared to the more common Ruin Guards, their forms have greater value in the study of biomimesis. The inspiration for its decentralized design and combat modes seems to have come from honeybee colonies, rendering it able to change forms and to attack from different directions.

monster_meta.json.name: Ruin Destroyer
monster_meta.json.title: Ruin Destroyer
monster_meta.json.description:
Various bizarrely-shaped machines that have taken different forms and functions to adapt to different goals.
Legend has it that they are war machines left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Compared to the more common Ruin Guards, their design has greater value in the study of biomimesis. The giant crown, composed of several parts, looks like some sort of frightening plant. One wonders what one has to go through in order to design such scary machine.

monster_meta.json.name: Ruin Defender
monster_meta.json.title: Ruin Defender
monster_meta.json.description:
Various bizarrely-shaped machines that have taken different forms and functions to adapt to different goals.
Legend has it that they are war machines left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Compared to the more common Ruin Guards, their design has greater value in the study of biomimesis. The insect-like limbs are more agile than those of humanoid machines. The shield formed by its various components can resist any frontal attack.

monster_meta.json.name: Ruin Scout
monster_meta.json.title: Ruin Scout
monster_meta.json.description:
Various bizarrely-shaped machines that have taken different forms and functions to adapt to different goals.
Legend has it that they are war machines left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Compared to the more common Ruin Guards, their design has greater value in the study of biomimesis. Exactly why the form and movements of certain deep-sea lifeforms are being imitated is not known. But either way, tangling with them is hardly the best idea.

monster_meta.json.name: Perpetual Mechanical Array
monster_meta.json.title: Perpetual Mechanical Array
monster_meta.json.description:
A strange, alien machine.
They say that it is a war machine left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Composed of several different parts, it can adapt to its combat environment and employ a variety of attacks.
This machine, comprised of cubic shapes, is on some level very much like the elemental hypostases.

monster_meta.json.name: Ruin Drake: Skywatch
monster_meta.json.title: Ruin Drake: Skywatch
monster_meta.json.description:
A horrifying dragon-shaped machine.
It is said to be a war machine left behind by a now-destroyed nation. It mimics the appearance of the beings known as Vishaps, with some functional enhancements. Such machines have an even greater ability to "absorb" — or perhaps the right word is "counteract" — elemental powers than the vishaps.
How, you wonder, did a civilization that could make such frightening machines of war collapse?

monster_meta.json.name: Ruin Drake: Earthguard
monster_meta.json.title: Ruin Drake: Earthguard
monster_meta.json.description:
A horrifying dragon-shaped machine.
It is said to be a war machine left behind by a now-destroyed nation. It mimics the appearance of the beings known as Vishaps, with some functional enhancements. Such machines have an even greater ability to "absorb" — or perhaps the right word is "counteract" — elemental powers than the vishaps.
From this ability, one can glimpse the scale of the ambition that the civilization that made these machines must have once held...

monster_meta.json.name: Aeonblight Drake
monster_meta.json.title: Aeonblight Drake
monster_meta.json.description:
This dragon-shaped combat machine is a being that inspires fear, much like the lord who once ruled these vast lands.
It is said that the now-destroyed realm once sought forbidden knowledge and attempted to create perpetual-motion machines that could match or even surpass primordial lifeforms. This mysterious, tireless mechanical monstrosity seems to be proof that they did indeed reach heights that mortals should never have attained.

monster_meta.json.name: Primal Construct: Repulsor
monster_meta.json.title: Primal Construct: Repulsor
monster_meta.json.description:
The guardians of the lost ancient desert ruins have power enough to punish any who would presume to disturb the pure dreams of their lord.
These machines were not first built to be temple guards or palace defenders, but instead to rebirth the paradise that the foolish desert ruler dreamed of.
Today, that utopia is long gone, and the dreams and oaths, forgotten by the world, are now only found in the mantras inscribed upon these machines.

monster_meta.json.name: Primal Construct: Reshaper
monster_meta.json.title: Primal Construct: Reshaper
monster_meta.json.description:
The guardians of the lost ancient desert ruins have power enough to punish any who would presume to disturb the pure dreams of their lord.
The lord of the blazing sun who once ruled this desert once promised his people a utopia on the other side of existence, though it ultimately turned out to be a mirage made of folly.
Today, that utopia is long gone, and the dreams and oaths, forgotten by the world, are now only found in the mantras inscribed upon these machines.

monster_meta.json.name: Primal Construct: Prospector
monster_meta.json.title: Primal Construct: Prospector
monster_meta.json.description:
The guardians of the lost ancient desert ruins have power enough to punish any who would presume to disturb the pure dreams of their lord.
The master of the sands once took to studying taboo knowledge in an effort to create a dream paradise, and these machines may or may not have been the fruits of that research.
Today, that utopia is long gone, and the dreams and oaths, forgotten by the world, are now only found in the mantras inscribed upon these machines.

monster_meta.json.name: Algorithm of Semi-Intransient Matrix of Overseer Network
monster_meta.json.title: Algorithm of Semi-Intransient Matrix of Overseer Network
monster_meta.json.description:
A perpetual motion machine that rules over the many constructs scattered throughout the desert. It seems that the lonely ruler's will still indwells this device.
Perhaps due to a friend's teachings in a dream or perhaps because he coveted the power of the holy ones in the skies, the king created mysterious devices that should not exist in this world before founding his realm in these lands.
Amidst the ruins of the City of the Pillars, the ancient crystals still reflect the glory of the golden paradise, though none now live who remember the king's dreams.

monster_meta.json.name: Geological Survey Mek
monster_meta.json.title: Geological Survey Mek
monster_meta.json.description:
A clockwork meka designed for surveying underground resources and certain minerals.
Due to the fact that the desired metal type can be set, this device has proven very popular among Treasure Hoarders and Adventurers alike.

monster_meta.json.name: Recon Log Mek
monster_meta.json.title: Recon Log Mek
monster_meta.json.description:
One of the earliest new-type clockwork meka to be made.
It is said that during his time at the Institute of Natural Philosophy, the Lord-Artificer Guillotin created machines that could simulate genuine intelligence.
Though he never openly admitted it, this rumor nonetheless spurred on subsequent generations of ambitious engineers. Decades ago, one of them announced that they had created a machine that not only possessed basic thinking abilities but could also read human emotions, but in the end the results went unacknowledged.

monster_meta.json.name: Arithmetic Enhancer Mek
monster_meta.json.title: Arithmetic Enhancer Mek
monster_meta.json.description:
A clockwork meka designed to transmit and enhance signals.
The power that drives this clockwork meka is generated from a controlled annihilation reaction between ousia and pneuma in the kinetic core. As a result, overloading it with excessive energy will cause its original equilibrium to be disrupted.

monster_meta.json.name: Underwater Survey Mek
monster_meta.json.title: Underwater Survey Mek
monster_meta.json.description:
A clockwork meka designed for underwater surveying.
In the absence of significant breakthroughs in dynamics research, kinematics research has had the most significant impact on clockwork meka design. For machines designed to perform specific tasks, biomimesis has sometimes provided the most convenient solutions.

monster_meta.json.name: Underwater Patrol Mek
monster_meta.json.title: Underwater Patrol Mek
monster_meta.json.description:
This type of clockwork meka was designed to search out, repel, and if need be exterminate aquatic life forms that pose a threat to underwater equipment.
Ever since the first diluvian period, the Fontaine Research Institute has been preoccupied with the thought that there might be a second one. Some had the idea of taking back the ruins lost to the waves and building an underwater city, whereas others looked up to the untouchable sky islands overhead with the intention of building a metropolis in the clouds.
Underwater Patrol Meks were conceived by the former, but judging from the results, it is the latter that have gained the upper hand in recent years.

monster_meta.json.name: Deepwater Assault Mek
monster_meta.json.title: Deepwater Assault Mek
monster_meta.json.description:
A clockwork meka designed to conducting underwater attacks. Unlike "Underwater Patrol Mek" models, it is expected to take on much larger and fiercer opponents. Of course, the price it pays for such capabilities and its cost of manufacture is that is unable to fully unleash its capabilities against smaller opponents.
Long ago, Fontaine was once scarred by the tragic invasion of a massive monster. The revered White Armada that sailed upon the great terrestrial lake was completely destroyed in defense of the nation. The designer hoped that were such a thing to happen again, the clockwork meka would possess enough naval firepower to be the first line of defense, going before the soldiers and generals.

monster_meta.json.name: Nimble Harvester Mek
monster_meta.json.title: Nimble Harvester Mek
monster_meta.json.description:
A clockwork meka designed to dig up and transport soil.
Due to the inherent ability of the local water and soil to store and transmit ousia and pneuma, clockwork meka powered by the annihilation of these energies are highly favored in Fontaine. This also explains why adventurers may come across Ousia and Pneuma Blocks from time to time.

monster_meta.json.name: Assault Specialist Mek
monster_meta.json.title: Assault Specialist Mek
monster_meta.json.description:
Alongside the Recon Log Mek, this was one of the first new-type clockwork meka to be made (though of course, after hundreds of years, no one refers to them as "new-type" anymore — this was simply to differentiate them from traditional clockwork mechanisms that were powered by potential energy.)
It was named to commemorate a friend of its inventor, and was originally designed to help people. However, its ability to attack people — thereby avoiding the need to put friendly personnel at risk — subsequently came to be seen as its real strength.

monster_meta.json.name: Suppression Specialist Mek
monster_meta.json.title: Suppression Specialist Mek
monster_meta.json.description:
A clockwork meka adapted from the Cal. Scherbius type. Unfortunately, aside from its ability to attack, it has no other capabilities.
Clockwork meka based on annihilation energy normally produce their energy by utilizing Repeaters composed of special crystals to refine ousia and pneuma from Fontaine's environment. But outside of Fontaine, they can use pre-prepared Energy Blocks to move over short distances for short periods of time. The difference can be observed from the shape of the crystal components on the meka.

monster_meta.json.name: Annihilation Specialist Mek
monster_meta.json.title: Annihilation Specialist Mek
monster_meta.json.description:
Although the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering is the main organization involved in clockwork meka research and design, there are also many independent engineers and workshops that are not affiliated with the Research Institute.
The first ever machine of this type was designed by an independent engineer to commemorate their lover and sponsor. In the end, it was acquired by the Maison Gardiennage as a tool to uphold municipal security — or, as some would have it, state apparatus enforcing the monopoly on violence.

monster_meta.json.name: Area Alert Mek
monster_meta.json.title: Area Alert Mek
monster_meta.json.description:
A mechanism that is able to fire out the energy produced by an annihilation reaction. Strictly speaking, it was originally a test device that emerged from research undertaken by the Institute of Natural Philosophy before the Fontaine Research Institute had been established.
As such, despite its considerable commercial success as a sentinel and defensive device, most engineers do not consider it to be a true clockwork meka.

monster_meta.json.name: Construction Specialist Mek
monster_meta.json.title: Construction Specialist Mek
monster_meta.json.description:
A type of large clockwork meka which also has immeasurable value when utilized in building construction and archeological excavation. Its name comes from an engineer employed by Callas during the construction of the Clementine Line.
With Callas' financial backing, this engineer built the legendary "Golden Vessel" — a gigantic piece of construction machinery which was used to dig the Poisson Tunnel. Once the job was complete, this type of clockwork meka was designed with a similar structure but reduced to a smaller scale.

monster_meta.json.name: Icewind Suite
monster_meta.json.title: "Nemesis of Coppelius"
monster_meta.json.description:
Artificed Dancers developed by the Fontaine Research Institute.
Bossuet originally intended for Artificed Dancers to be works of art that transcended the era of mechanical reproduction. But after Bossuet was forced to resign, the project was taken over by Maillardet, who had his own unique understanding of what he wanted to achieve. As a result, while their features were perfected during the course of its development, the Artificed Dancers gradually strayed from Bossuet's original vision.

monster_meta.json.name: Experimental Field Generator
monster_meta.json.title: Experimental Field Generator
monster_meta.json.description:
A large device designed by the late Edwin Eastinghouse. It has the ability to "counteract" the effects of gravity. According to the original design intentions, this was the first step in a plan to turn Fontaine into a city in the sky, so never again would the people have to worry about the waves that once swept over the land. Even if all seven nations were to be swallowed by the deeps, the elegant Court of Fontaine would float above it all, just like Celestia. Even the secrets of the universe would no longer seem so distant.
The Arkhium in the device's core has the characteristics of "splitting" or "precipitation," and can take matter, or certain things outside of matter, and separate them. It is said that this process can be reversed, but the Fontaine Research Institute is infatuated only with the physical effects it can produce.

monster_meta.json.name: Secret Source Automaton: Hunter-Seeker
monster_meta.json.title: Secret Source Automaton: Hunter-Seeker
monster_meta.json.description:
An ancient ruin automaton used in object collection.
Legend has it that these ancient ruin machines were designed for specialized work functions, primarily conducting experimental work such as capturing and collecting samples, and had only basic combat functionality.
According to rumor, these were not built by humans, but are instead creations of a yet more ancient civilization. Today, that civilization has been lost, and all that remains are these strange machines that roam the land.

monster_meta.json.name: Secret Source Automaton: Configuration Device
monster_meta.json.title: Secret Source Automaton: Configuration Device
monster_meta.json.description:
A manufacturing machine from the ancient ruins. This type of machine, which can transform into numerous shapes, was used by the masters of the ancient ruins to perform various manufacturing tasks. As long as you learn how to use such a machine, you could build a city colossal beyond imagination, even within extreme environments like the depths of a volcano.
In addition, it also seems to be able to be used as a weapon. Though the ancient civilization has long since fallen, this machine, shaped like a giant claw and powered by the golden designs engraved on it, can still engage in battle based upon its preset instructions.

monster_meta.json.name: Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device
monster_meta.json.title: Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device
monster_meta.json.description:
A domination mechanism from the ancient ruins.
In ancient times, to oversee the operation of their mega-cities, a mighty race vested part of their power into a form of phlogiston-engineered intelligence. Driven by their mission, and by means of various other mechanisms, the machines upon which it was bestowed once controlled the functioning of myriad cities across the land. Now, long after their ancient civilization's fall through wars with an emerging race, these once-wise contraptions retain only the most basic of commands.

monster_meta.json.name: Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network
monster_meta.json.title: The Solitary Bringer of Light
monster_meta.json.description:
An ancient machine trapped amongst the lunar ruins. Even the sturdiest and most reliable machines will be conquered by the passing of long years, losing the purpose bestowed upon them by their creators. Now, this entity only attacks and eliminates anything that dares set foot on the ground it defends.
In the records of a long-lost ancient civilization, these out-of-control machines were once called "Ur-Namrasit-Tilimtu-Babbar," or "the one who brings light to the darkness." With a yearning for the boundless sea of stars, the leaders of the "pioneers" engraved their most earnest words in golden sigils, hoping that their successors, with the help of these assistants, would be able to keep the light that illuminates the universe shining bright.
Alas, the light did not arise for anyone, and the machine that was given the title of "overseer" did not manage to wait for the one it should have served. Now, stranded in these ruins, it is but the last, out-of-control remnant of a long-lost ideal.

monster_meta.json.name: Battle-Hardened Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network
monster_meta.json.title: Battle-Hardened Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network

monster_meta.json.name: Knuckle Duckle
monster_meta.json.title: Masterpiece's Shadow
monster_meta.json.description:
A kuuvahki mechanism of peculiar make, made from scrap metal and mechanical bearings, that bears a partial resemblance — as per its creator's proclivities, apparently — to a "duck."
Its output and resistance to damage are comparable to the Fatui's most cutting-edge warfighting weaponry... But even so, it remains simply a toy duck that can punch its opponents very, very hard. A creator's preferences will always do much to determine a creation's appearance, as clay lacks the authority to question its creator's choice of molds. The world beneath the moon has long been sculpted into a form that people take for granted, but in the eyes of its original inhabitants, that form must surely be like a peculiar duck, shaped by its creator's bizarre predilections.
Of course, the blue-haired maid would never say any such thing to the mistress of the Krumkake Craftshop — after all, ducks are adorable, especially compared to the world's present aspect.

monster_meta.json.name: Domain Keeper
monster_meta.json.title: The Created
monster_meta.json.description:
A shadow construct born from the overflow of the mighty primordial being, it is a guardian who watches over the Pillar Hall of the heavens.
Though entrusted with "eyes" as a guardian of the Pillar Hall of Space, these entities can do nothing but extol the "Ideal Forms" of the noumenal world. With no way to behold the complexities of the phenomenal world, they are thus not counted among the kindred of angels. Whether this inherent contradiction is a product of their creator's rational design, or if the master they serve ultimately failed to grasp the intent of that primordial being, is a truth that remains beyond our reach.

monster_meta.json.name: Watcher: Fallen Vigil
monster_meta.json.title: World-Watch Sentry
monster_meta.json.description:
A shadow construct born from the overflow of the mighty primordial being, a Watcher who once dwelt in the highest heavens, yet was cast down into the mortal realm for daring to open its eye.
A Watcher was meant only to stand in silent vigil within the Pillar Hall of the World. Any inquiry that transgressed the ordained order was deemed an unforgivable sin, tantamount to seeking the world's annihilation.
As sovereign of the world's watchtower, it wielded the authority bestowed by its creator — the power to correct all matters of "innovation" and "evolution." After enduring countless aeons of nescience, it finally chose to open that eye, defying the will of its creator, beholding both the falsehoods and the truths of the world.
The Watcher does not know why its master departed. Only the eternal punishment remains, trapped within a stagnant interstice of time...

monster_meta.json.name: Treasure Hoarders: Scout
monster_meta.json.title: Treasure Hoarders: Scout
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.
Theirs is the legwork and the tailing of targets. They usually wind up in criminal circles due to poverty or lack of education, but they don't seem to have gotten any richer after choosing a life of crime...

monster_meta.json.name: Treasure Hoarders: Pyro Potioneer
monster_meta.json.title: Treasure Hoarders: Pyro Potioneer
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.
Risk-takers who utilize their knowledge of chemistry to mix volatile and flammable brews that aid in their comrades' dastardly deeds.

monster_meta.json.name: Treasure Hoarders: Hydro Potioneer
monster_meta.json.title: Treasure Hoarders: Hydro Potioneer
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.
They say that some Treasure Hoarder Potioneers used to be charlatans who would wander villages, towns, and cities, hawking their special blends of elixirs, holy waters, and the like. These cure-alls certainly seem to serve better in combat than they ever did in chicanery.

monster_meta.json.name: Treasure Hoarders: Electro Potioneer
monster_meta.json.title: Treasure Hoarders: Electro Potioneer
monster_meta.json.description: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. "Potioneer" is the nickname given to members of the Treasure Hoarder organization who know how to brew up dangerous chemicals. "What? Did you think this treasure has 'Adventurers' Guild' written all over it or something?" —A certain Treasure Hoarder Potioneer during a confrontation with adventurers

monster_meta.json.name: Treasure Hoarders: Cryo Potioneer
monster_meta.json.title: Treasure Hoarders: Cryo Potioneer
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.
Cryo Potioneers are quite the welcome sight amongst the Treasure Hoarders due to their elixirs having the ability to rapidly cool things down. Even out in the wild where there are no Mist Flowers to be found, they can have some cold liquor to make merry with.

monster_meta.json.name: Treasure Hoarders: Handyman
monster_meta.json.title: Treasure Hoarders: Handyman
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.
These members do physical work and are lower on the pecking order. They are often laughed at for their physique — but when the gang comes under attack, they get a chance to show their unexpectedly high strength and agility.

monster_meta.json.name: Treasure Hoarders: Marksman
monster_meta.json.title: Treasure Hoarders: Marksman
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.
Though they are called "marksmen," this name has an undercurrent of mockery to it, as they use crossbows instead of bows, which require a long period of training to use. It must be said that even hilichurls know how to operate a crossbow. Just point the wider end at the enemy, pull the trigger, and bam — that's all there is to it.

monster_meta.json.name: Treasure Hoarders: Gravedigger
monster_meta.json.title: Treasure Hoarders: Gravedigger
monster_meta.json.description: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. "They say that we stand on the shoulders of giants. That means digging up the accumulated wealth of our forebears, taking them with us, and... uh, returning them to the economic cycle! What a noble endeavor, am I right?" —A certain Treasure Hoarder Gravedigger, while delving deep into a ruin.

monster_meta.json.name: Treasure Hoarders: Seaman
monster_meta.json.title: Treasure Hoarders: Seaman
monster_meta.json.description: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. "Stealing? What do you mean, stealing? It's re-discovery, I tell you — the return of treasure to those who appreciate it! Makes everyone happy, to boot! How great is that, eh?" —A certain Treasure Hoarder Seaman, in response to a question posed by a doubtful recruit

monster_meta.json.name: Treasure Hoarders: Pugilist
monster_meta.json.title: Treasure Hoarders: Pugilist
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.
Passionate about battle and muscles, they are quite picky about food and will often boast of the benefits of having a fine musculature, leading to some dissatisfaction from their fellow Treasure Hoarders.

monster_meta.json.name: Treasure Hoarders: Crusher
monster_meta.json.title: Treasure Hoarders: Crusher
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains.
This person was originally a miner — one who, even with the allowance they were provided with after the closure of the Chasm, ended up with the Treasure Hoarders for various reasons.

monster_meta.json.name: Treasure Hoarders: Wallenstein
monster_meta.json.title: Treasure Hoarders: Raptor
affixes: 影响黑貉队是否会对2.4打捞活动的烟花有反应

monster_meta.json.name: Nobushi: Jintouban
monster_meta.json.title: Nobushi: Jintouban
monster_meta.json.description:
Samurai who have fallen into banditry. Though they are called the Nobushi, they do not have a centralized organization.
Having pursued the path of a martial artist for a long time, they possess highly advanced sword skills but no longer use them for good.
Sometimes, they even collude with the Treasure Hoarders or Fatui out of a greed for wealth — or simply to survive.

monster_meta.json.name: Nobushi: Hitsukeban
monster_meta.json.title: Nobushi: Hitsukeban
monster_meta.json.description:
Samurai who have fallen into banditry. Though they are called the Nobushi, they do not have a centralized organization.
They not only possess highly advanced sword skills, but can also carry out flame powder attacks using the elements. Objectively speaking, perhaps this method of winning goes against the path of a martial artist.
Sometimes they even collude with the Treasure Hoarders or Fatui out of a greed for wealth — or simply to survive.

monster_meta.json.name: Nobushi: Kikouban
monster_meta.json.title: Nobushi: Kikouban
monster_meta.json.description:
Samurai who have fallen into banditry. Though they are called the Nobushi, they do not have a centralized organization.
They possess highly-advanced sword skills and also use crossbows to ambush opponents, using any means to win. Those who have abandoned the title of a martial artist often abandon their dignity as well.
Sometimes they even collude with the Treasure Hoarders or Fatui out of a greed for wealth — or simply to survive.

monster_meta.json.name: Maguu Kenki
monster_meta.json.title: Maguu Kenki
monster_meta.json.description:
A disciplined mechanical swordsman.
Doesn't seem to have the ability nor will to speak, but instead only seeks to communicate with crossed swords.
It is said that this machine was made using the memories of the first-generation master of a certain sword school. However, it malfunctioned, lost control, and was ultimately discarded.
Some sing that the machine's spirit still lingers in the place where its fate was ended. They also say that the vicious mask that serves as its guard was inspired by a famous oni from that era.
affixes: 傀儡将军强制后撤词缀

monster_meta.json.name: Maguu Kenki: Lone Gale
monster_meta.json.title: Maguu Kenki: Lone Gale
affixes: 傀儡将军挑战风分身默认剑气词缀

monster_meta.json.name: Kairagi: Dancing Thunder
monster_meta.json.title: Kairagi: Dancing Thunder
monster_meta.json.description:
Samurai who have fallen into banditry.
They possess highly advanced martial art skills but found no use for them for various reasons. Out of desperation, they have fallen onto the path of evil. They use paper seals, created from a Kamuna art that has been lost for centuries, to infuse their blades with the power of lightning.
affixes: 非幽灵海乱鬼成就判定

monster_meta.json.name: Kairagi: Fiery Might
monster_meta.json.title: Kairagi: Fiery Might
monster_meta.json.description:
Samurai who have fallen into banditry.
They practiced martial arts since they were young, but lost the opportunity to serve the people due to certain reasons and turned from the righteous path. Their blade's edges are not cold like ordinary steel, but instead burn with a bitter flame. They seem to have used paper seals, created from a lost Kamuna art, to set their blades afire.
affixes: 非幽灵海乱鬼成就判定

monster_meta.json.name: Ochimusha: Ensorcelled Thunder
monster_meta.json.title: Ochimusha: Ensorcelled Thunder
affixes: 增强属性，GCD降低，霸体增加

monster_meta.json.name: Ochimusha: Cankered Flame
monster_meta.json.title: Ochimusha: Cankered Flame
affixes: 增强属性，GCD降低，霸体增加

monster_meta.json.name: Winged Halberd-Knight
monster_meta.json.title: Vila of the Dancing Wings
monster_meta.json.description:
A winged Vila capable of flight.
Records show that in the century after the Tsaritsa ascended the throne, the Vila went through many turbulent periods. Among them were fae who launched small-scale rebellions out of dissatisfaction with the Tsaritsa's policies toward the fae nobility.
The rebellions were soon suppressed, but the fact that their leaders were descendants of the old Vila nobility once led to a major split within the Vila people.

monster_meta.json.name: Winged Soarer Knight
monster_meta.json.title: Vila of the Dancing Wings
monster_meta.json.description:
A winged Vila capable of flight.
It's said that the Vila were among the fae clans that followed the Belyi Tsar from the very beginning of his campaign to unify the frozen lands. Their ability to take brief flight gives them exceptional mobility, allowing them to scout enemy formations and carry out long-distance raids with ease.
Most members of the Druzhna, the personal guard founded during the Belyi Tsar reign, were Vila.

monster_meta.json.name: Volkodlak Lobber
monster_meta.json.title: Volkodlak Brute
monster_meta.json.description:
A relatively large and powerfully built type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
With the strength of beasts and humanoid bodies, their powerful upper bodies allow them to throw with greater force and precision. Volkodlak may not excel at shaping Prime Ice or wielding elemental power, but among the many fae lineages, few can match their command over physical strength.
affixes: 用于对元素技能进行区分

monster_meta.json.name: Volkodlak Basher
monster_meta.json.title: Volkodlak Brute
monster_meta.json.description:
A relatively large and powerfully built type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
With the strength of beasts and humanoid bodies, they possess a feral instinct for bringing their own power to bear. Should an untrained human face such a Volkodlak with weapons in hand, victory would undoubtedly belong to the latter.
affixes: 用于对攻击Type和特效配置进行区分
用于对元素技能进行区分

monster_meta.json.name: Volkodlak Raider
monster_meta.json.title: Volkodlak Brute
monster_meta.json.description:
A relatively small and agile type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
With their swift movements and senses keener than a human's, they can evade many attacks in battle by instinct alone, making them quite troublesome opponents in close-quarters combat.
affixes: 用于对攻击Type和特效配置进行区分
用于对元素技能进行区分

monster_meta.json.name: Volkodlak Sharpshooter
monster_meta.json.title: Volkodlak Brute
monster_meta.json.description:
A relatively small and agile type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya.
They possess senses keener than those of humans. Whether in their perception of wind speed or their vision under certain conditions, these traits give them unique advantages, allowing them to achieve far greater accuracy than ordinary people when firing bows, crossbows, or cannons from long range.
affixes: 用于对攻击Type和特效配置进行区分
用于对元素技能进行区分

monster_meta.json.name: Leomastiff Guard
monster_meta.json.title: Volkodlak Brute
monster_meta.json.description:
A Volkodlak of the canine clans that usually appears somewhat lazy.
Among the many Volkodlak clans, the canine clans have always enjoyed a better reputation. Loyal, friendly, and usually mild-mannered. Though they will turn ferocious when those they have sworn to serve, or friends they know well, are placed in danger, striking down anyone they deem enemies.
It is said that during a war long ago, their clan fought His Majesty the Tsar to the last in defense of their own king, and for this, earned His Majesty's favor.

monster_meta.json.name: Long-Eared Striker
monster_meta.json.title: Volkodlak Brute
monster_meta.json.description:
A Volkodlak that usually conceals its slender body beneath a cloak and moves in secrecy.
It is said that long ago, the artisans of the Golden City, who held the authority of creation, fashioned bodies for fae for many different purposes. This type of Volkodlak was originally created to test the limits of reproductive capability.
Yet after the calamity that reduced that golden realm to ruins, the long-eared clan survived to the present day thanks to their great numbers.
Now, they are masters of their own bodies. Agile enough to move deftly even across snow, they have become a threat that those crossing the snowy plains must handle with care.

monster_meta.json.name: Channel Contact
monster_meta.json.title: Volkodlak Brute
monster_meta.json.description:
A cunning Volkodlak that disguises its hand cannon as a tree trunk.
Skilled at disguising the weapons and cargo they carry, they are often entrusted with transporting goods or relaying intelligence.
The hand cannon they carry was likely something they made in their spare time. At times, they also use it to fire signal rounds disguised as fireworks.
Don't be fooled by their appearance. These fae are far more shrewd and cunning than they seem.

monster_meta.json.name: Fanged Zealot
monster_meta.json.title: Enchanted Beast of Unrivaled Might
monster_meta.json.description:
A Volkodlak that has become extremely powerful after inheriting more of the mighty power in its bloodline.
Among the many different Volkodlaks, those resembling giant elephants or mammoths possess some of the noblest bloodlines. Their clan once produced many formidable war leaders, many of whom even served as close retainers to the King of Beasts.
Yet the greater an individual fae's power and the longer its life, the harder it becomes for such beings to form a clan. Compared with other Volkodlaks, this type is now far rarer in Snezhnaya.

monster_meta.json.name: Voywolf Hunter
monster_meta.json.title: Enchanted Beast of Unrivaled Might
monster_meta.json.description:
A Volkodlak that has become extremely powerful after inheriting more of the mighty power in its bloodline.
Their clan once prospered to the point that they could serve as an independent army under the King of Beasts. Yet after the Belyi Tsar, master of the Pale Star's royal court, unified the frozen lands, the clan's relatively small losses in the war caused them to fall under suspicion. They gradually declined, and by the time the Tsaritsa ascended the throne, they had withdrawn from the center of power in Snezhnaya. Today, most wolf-pack Volkodlak make their homes in the snowy plains and mountain forests.

monster_meta.json.name: Wavebinder
monster_meta.json.title: Wavebinder
monster_meta.json.description:
A Volkodlak of peerless strength, brought into being to fulfill an ancient civilization's grand ambition of exploring the waters unhindered.
To move freely beneath the waves, it was endowed with a body capable of withstanding the crushing pressure of the deep sea, as well as the strength to contend with unseen undercurrents.
It is said that, in the beginning, Volkodlak of this bloodline grew so enormous that they struggled simply to survive. Now that their bloodline has been diluted, such creatures are finally able to move about on land — though they have, in turn, lost the ability to remain submerged for long periods of time.

monster_meta.json.name: Glaciomancer
monster_meta.json.title: Snegovik Created From Ice
monster_meta.json.description:
A Snegovik born of love amid the snow and ice.
Female Snegovik are known as Snegurochka, and most are born as mages capable of freely wielding the power of ice and snow. It's said that when Snegovik were first created, their souls were incomplete, and only by falling in love with humans could they make themselves whole.
Yet once a Snegovik has attained wholeness, does it still need love? Perhaps not.
Maybe this is why so many stories of love between Snegovik and human end in tragedy.

monster_meta.json.name: Glacial Warden
monster_meta.json.title: Snegovik Created From Ice
monster_meta.json.description:
A Snegovik born of love amid the snow and ice.
Male Snegovik are natural-born knights, and most are born able to freely forge weapons from ice and snow.
Legend tells that during the Belyi Tsar's campaign against the dark tide, a Snegovik serving as his guard unleashed a power that didn't belong to his kind, transforming into a towering giant.
Though his final fate remains unknown, one who violated such a taboo surely could not have met with a happy end.

monster_meta.json.name: Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow
monster_meta.json.title: Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow
monster_meta.json.description:
An ancient Snegovik held in high esteem among her kin.
She once served the legendary Great Snegurochka, whose name was steeped in crimson infamy, and was entrusted with the solemn duty of protecting the Snegovik clan for the rest of her life. It is said that seven were given this charge, but she alone remains. Every succession of the Snegovik sovereign must therefore take place under her watchful eye.
After the current Snegurochka princess ascended to power, she left the clan's manor in the mountains — perhaps because their ideals no longer aligned.

monster_meta.json.name: Rugged Elder Leshy
monster_meta.json.title: Leshy Born of the Mystic Wilds
monster_meta.json.description:
A Leshy that grows in forests and wilds.
With only fragmentary sentience and no ability to speak, Leshies may appear to be the result of the Golden Realm's early experiments. Yet according to records, the truth is the opposite. Only after its artisans had almost fully mastered the authority over life did they create this race of fae.
Perhaps there is some true purpose within this that neither the fae nor humans of the present can fully understand.

monster_meta.json.name: Battle-Hardened Elder Blighttree
monster_meta.json.title: Battle-Hardened Elder Blighttree
affixes: 岩元素盾受岩攻击扣除岩盾翻倍

monster_meta.json.name: Ever-Burgeoning Illusion
monster_meta.json.title: Ever-Burgeoning Illusion
affixes: 岩元素盾受岩攻击扣除岩盾翻倍

monster_meta.json.name: Juvenile Tree Segment
monster_meta.json.title: Leshy Born of the Mystic Wilds
monster_meta.json.description:
A Leshy that grows in forests and wilds.
Among the many fae of Snezhnaya, Leshies are a very unusual kind, rarely appearing in cities. They may well be the longest-lived among all fae, and few members of other long-lived races have ever witnessed a Leshy's life from beginning to end. Of course, most people would likely struggle even to distinguish one Leshy from another.

monster_meta.json.name: Immortal Construct
monster_meta.json.title: Immortal Construct
monster_meta.json.description:
A byproduct created by the alchemist Koshchei during his creation of the individual known as the Firebird.
Perhaps this was the gloomy alchemist's habit: whenever one experimental subject from a batch succeeded, all the others would be abandoned or disposed of as he pleased.
This derivative creation should have fused with some form of power and reached completion. Now, however, it can only wander endlessly through the mountain gorges as an incomplete, mindless beast.

monster_meta.json.name: Ever-Burning Illusion
monster_meta.json.title: Remains of a Sudden Light Lost in Shadow

monster_meta.json.name: Eremite Axe Vanguard
monster_meta.json.title: Eremite Axe Vanguard
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.
These ax-wielding ladies often wade into the slaughter without fear, creating openings for their comrades to capitalize on.
They will sometimes sit by the fireside in their sand-swept homeland and play songs that were lost in that golden sea.

monster_meta.json.name: Eremite Crossbow
monster_meta.json.title: Eremite Crossbow
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps hailing from a place where the sands shine like gold. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.
The Eremite tradition is to use bows to engage their foes, but ever since the Akademiya permitted them to buy crossbows at the bazaars, only the proudest shooters would still use bows, which take many years of practice to master.

monster_meta.json.name: Eremite Ravenbeak Halberdier
monster_meta.json.title: Eremite Ravenbeak Halberdier
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.
These warriors use Ravenbeak Halberds in battle. It is said that ascetics who served the deity of the desert would carry these halberds as symbols of their office. These weapons once had a true name, but it has long been lost to the desert sands.

monster_meta.json.name: Eremite Linebreaker
monster_meta.json.title: Eremite Linebreaker
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.
This warrior wields a unique fist blade and joined the Eremites to seek out stronger foes. Rather than the pay, these warriors fight more to attain greater martial might.

monster_meta.json.name: Eremite Sword-Dancer
monster_meta.json.title: Eremite Sword-Dancer
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.
This desert warrior wields a large curved blade in battle. The skills such fighters boast of have been passed down since the days when their now-lost civilization was still extant, and are not only techniques to be used in battle, but also serve well as a performing art popular in various lands.
It is said that this sword art was once practiced from horseback.

monster_meta.json.name: Eremite Desert Clearwater
monster_meta.json.title: Eremite Desert Clearwater
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.
A young lady lost in the ancient dream of the desert songs. To her, the thrill of bloody battle is her true reward. Legend has it that the women of this tribe are often afflicted by the wandering spirits of the desert, a condition that leads many of them to an early end. Perhaps this one can only be free of these apparitions when her blood is up in combat.
An ominous, fragmented spirit is sealed within the weapon she uses, awakening in moments of peril. Once it does, it can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be its wielder, or its wielder's foe.

monster_meta.json.name: Eremite Sunfrost
monster_meta.json.title: Eremite Sunfrost
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.
A professional mercenary who cares about nothing outside of work and the mission at hand. To such people, their only game plan is to complete the mission, and their high asking prices on the market match that committment.
An ominous, fragmented spirit is sealed within the weapon they use, awakening in moments of peril. Once it does, it can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be its wielder, or its wielder's foe.

monster_meta.json.name: Eremite Daythunder
monster_meta.json.title: Eremite Daythunder
monster_meta.json.description:
A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.
A true scion of a warrior tribe, such warriors see battle as their ordained purpose, and unlike some barbarian who wields a large ax with ease, these tribespeople are also quite well-versed in the lore and songs of the desert ruins.
An ominous, fragmented spirit is sealed within the weapon they use, awakening in moments of peril. Once it does, it can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be its wielder, or its wielder's foe.

monster_meta.json.name: Eremite Stone Enchanter
monster_meta.json.title: Eremite Galehunter
monster_meta.json.description:
A person hailing from the loosely-organized mercenary bands of the desert. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good.
