BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Twilight Phantom Thief
BeyondItem.json.Description:
Twilight Phantom Thief Set. Gear meant for moving when dusk falls all around, robbing the wicked in the name of justice, striking down the vile while never letting one's flawless image slip.

On Planet #31, where the threat from the stars ran deep, no sooner had the civilization-scale act of hiding begun than certain fanatics began scheming, trying to signal the skies, willing to drag all of humanity down with them into their lives, bereft of hope. In answer, two "phantom thieves" put their long-honed illusion skills together with peerless physical prowess and struck first, again and again stealing away the fanatics' signaling devices and shattering their fantasy of calling forth ruin. Even Octavia was mistaken for a target by them at one point.

After making peace with the two thieves and sharing a pleasant conversation, Octavia proposed they hold a grand illusion show, destroying those signaling devices in front of everyone as a warning to the remaining fanatics. To make it happen, Octavia stepped in to coordinate between all the necessary parties, seeing the perfect performance through to its close...

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Azure Mountainshade
BeyondItem.json.Description:
Azure Mountainshade Set. Casual wear that plays up its sporty elements: light, quick, and just right for outings in mild mountain weather.

The climate of Planet #503, the "Ocean World," is a peculiar one, seemingly summer year-round, and no cooler far inland than it is by the sea. On top of that, mountains on the planet don't reach great heights, so even at the summit, you're spared the sting of biting wind.

When Octavia and her friends from the Academy Planet went hiking there, she habitually bundled up the two young researchers against the cold, only for them to end up sweltering at the summit. Luckily, a local outdoor-gear shopkeeper stepped in to help, gifting them several outfits with just the right weight. The one that stuck most in Octavia's memory was this one, azure in its base tone, like "the sky over the summit just before sunrise."

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Letter Crane Courier
BeyondItem.json.Description:
Letter Crane Courier Set. If it can carry a message through the storms between the stars, is it still a paper crane?

While Octavia was passing the time on Planet #507, a lawsuit was dragging on between her, the company she'd rented her spacecraft from, and the authority that managed the shipping lanes of that stellar region. The pair sent out to receive the physical evidence, the two messengers dispatched by the regional authority, were unfailingly polite, and both their uniforms and their vessel looked for all the world like paper cranes. They left a deep impression on Octavia. Even after she was ambushed by the opposing side's tricks and legal wolves and lost the case, they still went out of their way to recommend a more reliable rental company to her next time...

BeyondItem.json.Description:
Crowned by the Breeze Set. A botanist's expedition wear, designed to handle sweltering environments.

On the shallows of Planet #503, the "Ocean World," Octavia crossed paths with a pair of teachers who looked barely more than children themselves, and they recognized her at a single glance. It turned out they were researchers on assignment from the civilization of Planet #93, the "Academy Planet." Not only had they heard tell of Octavia back on the Academy Planet, but they had also visited Planet #311, the "Garden Planet." Now, meeting her here of all places truly qualified as a top-tier stroke of serendipity.

Hearing that the main purpose of their star-hopping was to collect rare plants, Octavia invited them to head into the mountains, and together with the researchers and their traveling students, set off on an inland expedition...

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Amber Nectar
BeyondItem.json.Description:
Amber Nectar Set. Using the power of a contract, sweetness and mellow flavor are drawn together into a marvelous drink to be shared with one's companions.

Octavia's stay on Planet #507 happened to run exactly a year in local reckoning, so, casting aside the sourness of losing the lawsuit, she was fortunate enough to witness the second of the planet's hide-and-seek contract ceremonies.

The "hunters" taking part this time weren't just the usual cats and dogs. There were butterflies, birds, flying fish, even dragons from the fairy tales of other planets... The competitors who held out the longest, thanks to a love of flowers and the distinctive fragrance clinging to them, were found by a "Sweetnectar Bee." Once the contract was signed, that pair, a young man and young woman, could call upon their spiritual power to channel the essence of flowers directly into water, skipping long hours and elaborate steps to brew sweet honey outright. To celebrate, they threw a feast for every competitor and every spectator at the ceremony. Octavia herself got a taste of that amber masterwork, and just like that, the sourness of the day had fled far away...

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Whimsical Spectacle
BeyondItem.json.Description:
Whimsical Spectacle Set. Master illusionists bent on "deceiving the very stars" once wore these formal costumes onto the most exalted stages, with gravitas and grace as much a part of the act as anything else.

Early in her travels, Octavia arrived at Planet #31, which looked barren from above, though "parts of its surface bore the marks of human work." After landing, she discovered a civilization with widespread mastery of combustion engineering. What set them apart was that they lived clustered, nearly obsessively, in a hundred cities, combining giant canvases and living plants to "raise umbrellas" over every building, trying to disguise each city as a forest or a stretch of empty hills...

This strange phenomenon traced back to a single astronomer's warning. With a simple but effective telescope, he had captured the process of many stars being devoured by an "unnameable pitch-blackness," compiled his evidence in painstaking detail, and then spent thirty years lobbying every faction he could reach, convincing them all to undertake this civilization-scale act of disguise.

"Fighting a thing like that is a fool's hope. We have to hide, buy ourselves time, lay down a technological foundation firm enough to matter..."

As the astronomer's own children, a pair of young siblings were shaped from infancy by the terrors beyond the sky, dreaming they might one day solve the problem for good. And then a phantom thief's illusion show gave them the direction they'd throw everything into...

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic: Whimsical Spectacle - Sugarcube Sleight
BeyondItem.json.Description:
An upgraded version of the Whimsical Spectacle Set. master illusionists bent on "deceiving the very stars" once wore these formal costumes onto the most exalted stages, with gravitas and grace as much a part of the act as anything else.

After the phantom thieves' show-stopping performance, the astronomer's children, moved to the core, sought the two out and became their students. In just two years, they had surpassed their teachers, becoming a new generation of master illusionists.

"If illusions can bring down fanatics, it can surely be used to hide cities too... provided the budget's there, and everyone plays their part."

On the eve of Octavia's departure, the two master illusionists gained one last smidge of aid from their otherworldly visitor. Thus, they mounted the second grand illusion show, unprecedented then and never quite matched since. Their command of the art was all but flawless. They wrapped the busiest city in the world in the illusion of a mountain, and from a hot-air balloon in the clouds, you couldn't spot the seams. If this technique could be applied stably across every city, they might really be able to fool the dangerous eyes above the sky...

Even years later, Octavia would still, from time to time, take out her photo with the two master illusionists, remember the details of that night's performance, and gaze through her telescope at the planet "that seemed to have no civilization," silently wishing that they might hold on, quietly and patiently building up the strength they'd need...

BeyondItem.json.Description:
The Twilight Web Set. An elegant and mysterious-looking set of formalwear in deep purple, adorned with an exquisite spiderweb pattern. Put it on, and you instantly take on an aura that feels both noble and forbidding.

An organization known as the Webweavers, about which very little is actually known, was said to be active on Planet No. 777. According to rumor, they had adopted the pitch-black spider as their totem of dread, and had been studying forbidden magic in an attempt to obtain abyssal power strong enough to enslave even souls. Fully aware of how dangerous this could be, Octavia decided to take part in the operation to capture the Webweavers. However, it turned out that they were merely a group of young people preparing to celebrate Candlelit Revelry Night, and most of the frightening language that had led to such a massive misunderstanding was simply quotes from various popular books...

BeyondItem.json.Description:
The Fireflies of Hope Set. This exquisite and elegant outfit is made of soft sky-blue silk and adorned with a bright yellow ribbon. With the moon hanging high overhead, the air cool and crisp, and fireflies glowing all around, what better night could there be to gather and celebrate?

Octavia spent some time on Planet No. 66, where the locals happened to be celebrating their grandest "Bright Moon Festival." During these festivities, people would gather beneath the bright moon and admire fireflies dancing in the sky... except that the fireflies had long since disappeared from the world due to calamity and ill fortune. Nevertheless, the people of this planet remained optimistic, showing up dressed in their finest with Firefly Lanterns that symbolized hope in hand. Octavia spent some time on Planet No. 66, where the locals happened to be celebrating their grandest "Bright Moon Festival." During these festivities, people would gather beneath the bright moon and admire fireflies dancing in the sky... except that the fireflies had long since disappeared from the world due to calamity and ill fortune. BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - "Idyllic Melodies"
BeyondItem.json.Description:
The Idyllic Melodies Set. This is a simple yet heartwarming outfit inspired by adorable dairy cows grazing at pasture.

On Planet No. 507, Octavia encountered a couple of Defeaters who unfortunately had been eliminated from the Hide-and-Seek ritual they were participating in after only two rounds and had no choice but to enter into an agreement with the goofy-looking cow spirits. However, they seemed rather quite pleased with the development, regarding the two cow spirits as their buddies, and eventually found a quiet locale to settle down in with them and establish a verdant pasture. And eventually, Fortune knocked on their door: One day, the two Defeaters stumbled upon the cow spirits' true potential, which was the ability to turn the green grass of the pasture into high-quality buttermilk that could rival any dairy product on the market. After Octavia put them in touch with a reliable distributor, the two Defeaters did not seek to make a huge profit from their new product, choosing to sell it at an affordable price instead. And later on, Octavia chose to remember their honesty and diligence with this outfit...

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - "The Art of Spontaneity"
BeyondItem.json.Description:
The Art of Spontaneity Set. Bursting with creative passion and daring imagination that pushes the boundaries of convention, and an ambition to turn the world into a canvas: graffiti is all about the courage to break free and create.

As forests change and evolve over time, they inevitably go through periods of growth and decline. The same is true of "The Forest of Steel." The difference is, while natural forests can slowly recover starting with a thin layer of moss, The Forest of Steel tends to leave behind nothing but a jarring scar: vast swathes of debris when they fall into ruin. The good thing is, there are always artists willing to pick up their brushes and pour their passion into these ruins, much like the humble yet resilient moss that tries to breathe new life into the lifeless forest of steel. Octavia managed to witness this revival and re-creation firsthand while on Planet No. 118. Crumbling walls and broken ruins were brought back to life in vivid colors, transforming them into a new canvas for people to unleash their creativity. This uninhibited passion and boldness to create left a deep impression on her...

BeyondItem.json.Description:
The Feathers of Justice Set. The doves that bring an end to conflict are not always meek and gentle, for the feathers raised to safeguard peace can sometimes hide a keen edge...

Planet No. 507, which lies at the busiest crossroads of interstellar travel, is surrounded by factions with murky backgrounds and even murkier intentions. While Octavia was pursuing legal action over the spaceship accident, these factions, each with their own ulterior motives, also tried to skirt the law by engineering accidents and destroying evidence to avoid the compensation they were legally obligated to pay. Fortunately, the feather-adorned officers responsible for policing the interstellar routes stepped in and swiftly put a stop to these schemes with a decisive show of force. Though understated in their manner, these formidable officers understood that extraordinary times called for extraordinary measures, and that to preserve peace you sometimes have to employ more than just words...

It was on a warm, sunny afternoon that Octavia stumbled upon an apple orchard on Planet No. 311. In this rarely visited orchard lived two "Flower Whisperers" who believed that, just like beautiful flowers, the fruits that brought so much sweetness to people's lives also deserved to be tended to through conversation. The two of them also invited Octavia to taste the fruit they had just plucked from the trees. Amid the fresh, fruity scent rich in the air, she recorded the outfits they were wearing...

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - "Sweet Baker's Dreams"
BeyondItem.json.Description:
The Sweet Baker's Dreams Set. A comfortable and practical chef's uniform inspired by delicious sweet pastries. Its vibrant colors seem to embody the magic of transforming ordinary ingredients into sweet wonders, with every dessert becoming a delightful surprise for the palate.

Making a delicious and exquisite-looking dessert often takes a tremendous amount of time and effort. But seeing the joy and delight it brings to someone else makes all that hard work worthwhile.

Following the completion of several theme parks on Planet No. 712, the park operators decided to hire two pastry chefs to stay on permanently. Both chefs seemed to have mastered the magic of dessert-making. No matter what sweet treat their customers asked for, they could whip it up in the blink of an eye, and their creations never failed to earn rave reviews.

Octavia once had the chance to watch the two chefs at work and offered her thoughts afterward: "There was nothing particularly special about any of it. The ingredients and kitchenware they used were perfectly ordinary. Maybe their passion is the real 'magic' that makes these desserts so tasty..."

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - "Osmanthus in the Moonlight"
BeyondItem.json.Description:
The Osmanthus in the Moonlight Set. The crisp, cool air of fall has arrived, and the osmanthus gleams bright beneath the moon. Though misfortune may still reign for a while, humanity's will and wisdom will not be so easily broken... 

By the time Octavia approached Planet No. 66, its people had already spent thousands of star-years wrestling with misfortune. Once, they had thrown everything they had into battling that pitch-black darkness, and somehow learned to find little joys even in the midst of utter despair. Whenever the planet began to drift farther from its star, the star's warmth would slowly fade, and the misfortune would once again come creeping back. Even the bright moon celebrated in stories passed down through generations would disappear with it. In response, the people built a vast structure, its warm golden light glowing softly like the blossoms of the osmanthus. It stood as both a place to study and resist the misfortune and a place where people could gather with their loved ones during festivals, finding joy in one another's company and drawing strength to face the misfortune when it returned...

The Ascended Osmanthus in the Moonlight Set. It radiates a warm, lustrous glow like that of osmanthus blossoms, with a faint yet unbreakable light of resolve shining from within.

During that festival where the planet would reach the farthest point from its star, Octavia, the visitor from afar, received an invitation to visit a watchpost on Planet No. 66 and share her personal experiences with the dark-purple misfortune with some remarkable individuals. And in this giant structure high above the pitch-black canopy, the planet's finest geomancers showed her how they drew on ancient legends to inscribe the Osmanthus Skyglow Seal across the entire planet, guiding the misfortune as it surged like a raging flood and keeping it from striking Planet No. 66. It was also on this occasion that they took a branch from an osmanthus tree, said to be capable of warding off the pitch-black misfortune, and gave it to her as a gift as they wished her a smooth and safe journey through the stars. Now, whenever Octavia takes a look at that osmanthus branch, she silently wishes for the day when that planet, still making its quiet way through the endless night, can finally tear through the heavy fog and embrace the ancient moon once more...

They resolved to compose a grand work unlike any heard before and perform it when the "noise" reached its peak, guiding the chaotic sounds into harmonious, resonant echoes.

Upon her arrival, Octavia saw the steadfast resolve on the two musicians' faces as they prepared to take the stage. Moved by their unwavering devotion to music, she took great care to record this splendid formal attire, a symbol of order and the laws of music...

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Polyphonic Variations: Verdant Reverie
BeyondItem.json.Description:
The Ascended Polyphonic Variations set. Its vibrant teal seem imbued with the pure power that could still all clamor.

When the wild, chaotic noise swept across Planet 12, the two musicians donned this attire and took to the stage for a magnificent duet unlike any before or since.

As their music rose, they confronted the frenzied noise head-on with exquisite mastery of the profound laws of music... At last, the clamor and chaos dissolved into stirring echoes that drifted into the distance, and peace returned to the planet after a long absence.

By the time Octavia departed, the two musicians' feat of quelling the noise through music had become a legend known in every household. Even years later, whenever Octavia recalled that wondrous performance that had resounded through heaven and earth, she would still wish that the planet, flourishing amid beautiful melodies, would forever remain pure and at peace...

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - "Afternoon Nectar Half-Up Hairstyle"
BeyondItem.json.Description: A playful tied hairstyle featuring a vivid, radiant red hue. With delicate wisps of loose hair framing the face with airy grace, it exudes a lively, spirited charm.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - "Afternoon Nectar Hair Ornament"
BeyondItem.json.Description: A delicate ribbon hair ornament in leafy hues, radiating a refreshing beauty. Serving as a subtle styling accent, it lends the wearer a touch of effortless grace.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - "Afternoon Nectar Glasses"
BeyondItem.json.Description: A pair of round glasses finished in a brown hue, imbuing the wearer with an air of understated elegance and scholarly charm.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - "Afternoon Nectar Socks"
BeyondItem.json.Description: Soft, comfortable light gray socks that fit snugly against the skin. Their breathable fabric makes every stroll a comfortable one.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - "Afternoon Nectar Top"
BeyondItem.json.Description: A loose-fitting casual top adorned with playful, easygoing fruit motifs. Its comfortable, breathable fabric lets a boy stroll freely in the sunshine.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - "Afternoon Nectar Pants"
BeyondItem.json.Description: Neatly tailored casual pants with clean, simple pant legs accented by small fruit motifs. Fresh and comfortable, they combine a clean look with an easy fit.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - "Afternoon Nectar Casual Shoes"
BeyondItem.json.Description: A comfortable pair of casual shoes with durable dark uppers that stand up well to wear and dirt. Even after frequent walks along dirt paths, they keep the wearer's feet comfortable.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - "Afternoon Nectar Short Hair"
BeyondItem.json.Description: Neat, refreshing red short hair with slightly upturned ends, full of a boy's youthful energy. On warm afternoons, a faint fruity fragrance seems to linger among the strands.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - "Afternoon Nectar Hat"
BeyondItem.json.Description: A playful hat shaped like a ripe apple, adding a touch of youthful energy and vitality to the wearer's look.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - "Afternoon Nectar Glasses"
BeyondItem.json.Description: A pair of round glasses finished in a brown hue, imbuing the wearer with an air of understated elegance and scholarly charm.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Top
BeyondItem.json.Description: A simple yet stylish top in blue and white, featuring handy multipurpose pockets and a warm-yellow neckerchief. A cheerful blend of good looks and everyday practicality.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Shorts
BeyondItem.json.Description: Dark-brown cargo shorts with distinctive geometric detailing along the folded hems. Their crisp, practical cut makes them just the thing for everyday repair work.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Long Boots
BeyondItem.json.Description: Work boots with fold-over cuffs and a striking combination of cream and bright yellow. Their thick, hard-wearing soles offer sturdy support without weighing down your steps.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Twin Tails
BeyondItem.json.Description: Playfully colored hair styled into twin ponytails, with ends that curl ever so slightly. A bouncy, spirited look bursting with youthful energy.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Headband
BeyondItem.json.Description: A bright-yellow headband topped with a cheerful bow, bringing a delightful burst of energy and cuteness to any look.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Gloves
BeyondItem.json.Description: Soft, snug-fitting brown fingerless gloves that keep the palms protected while leaving the fingers free to work with even the tiniest parts.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Over-the-Knee Socks
BeyondItem.json.Description: Dark over-the-knee socks with decorative stitching around the cuffs. Their close fit follows the shape of the legs, adding depth and a stylish layered finish to the outfit.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekina Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Waist Accessory
BeyondItem.json.Description: A handy storage case worn at the waist, fitted with quirky little duck-shaped parts. Its bright red-and-yellow design adds a dash of childlike fun to an otherwise serious work outfit.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Top
BeyondItem.json.Description: A dark work vest fitted with a small tool pouch and paired with a geometric-print neckerchief. Neat, lightweight, and ready for whatever the day's tinkering brings.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Pants
BeyondItem.json.Description: Light-colored cargo pants with plenty of pockets, contrasting dark leg panels, and a plaid waist wrap. Their relaxed cut leaves plenty of room to move, whether you're hard at work or on the go.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Long Boots
BeyondItem.json.Description: Tough, dark work boots fitted with metal buckles and bold red toe caps. Thick, slip-resistant soles keep your footing firm and steady, wherever the job takes you.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Short Hair
BeyondItem.json.Description: Brightly colored short hair with soft, tousled layers and ends that flick up playfully. The fresh, lively style captures a young repairer's sharp instincts and boundless energy.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Headband
BeyondItem.json.Description: A simple, practical work headband tied in a tidy knot. It keeps stray strands neatly out of the way while giving the wearer a fresh, energetic look.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Gloves
BeyondItem.json.Description: Fingerless gloves with wide wrist guards, tough enough to resist everyday wear and scratches while leaving the fingers free for delicate, precise work.

BeyondItem.json.Name: Manekin Cosmetic - Tinker's Treasures Waist Accessory
BeyondItem.json.Description: A handy parts case worn at the waist, with a sturdy yellow shell built to last. A trusty companion no repairer would want to head out without.

Reliquary.json.Name: Traveling Doctor's Pocket Watch

Reliquary.json.Name: Frost-Weaved Dignity

Reliquary.json.Name: Icebreaker's Resolve
Reliquary.json.Description: A feather that exudes a chilly aura. One can almost feel the turbulent winds that brought it here, wailing over snow-covered plains and between frosty peaks.

Reliquary.json.Name: Broken Rime's Echo
Reliquary.json.Description: The crown of an ancient hero who dreamt of conquering the cold. It is proof of its former master's bravery in facing the bone-chilling cold of winter.

Reliquary.json.Name: Snowswept Memory

Reliquary.json.Name: Frozen Homeland's Demise
Reliquary.json.Description: A timepiece from a nation of old that waited for their warriors' return. What flows inside is not sand, but bits of ice that never melt.

Reliquary.json.Description: A timepiece that recorded the gladiator's days in the bloodstained Colosseum. To him, it counted down the days on his long road to freedom.

Reliquary.json.Name: Mystic's Gold Dial
Reliquary.json.Description: A golden disc shaped like a sun. The draconic patterns on it seem to symbolize the cycle of life and death.

Reliquary.json.Name: Pre-Banquet of the Contenders
Reliquary.json.Description: A vessel that seems to have been made by twisting and forming stone in a seemingly whimsical fashion. But it is an open question as to who possesses such strength...

Reliquary.json.Name: Root of the Spirit-Marrow
Reliquary.json.Description: A feathered accessory made in imitation of an ancient dragon's wing. Perhaps it was once a memento of some forgotten history.

Reliquary.json.Name: Crown of the Saints
Reliquary.json.Description: A crown made of obsidian that in ancient times was used in coronation ceremonies by noble tribal kings.

Reliquary.json.Name: Reckoning of the Xenogenic
Reliquary.json.Description: A flower meticulously carved from black crystal. It emits a mysterious light at night.

Reliquary.json.Name: Myths of the Night Realm
Reliquary.json.Description: A mysterious ritual element that is neither a timepiece nor a compass. Nowadays, no one has any idea what it is used for.

Reliquary.json.Description: The high heavens bestowed a splendid crown on their envoy, and arrogance was born out of power unchecked.

Reliquary.json.Name: Heavensent Decree
Reliquary.json.Description: The high heavens bestowed a sundial of counter-time on their envoy, and an inviolable interdiction became a wellspring of rage.

Reliquary.json.Name: Foundryman's Magnanimity
Reliquary.json.Description: He knew that, unlike the flame at the heart of the furnace, which would continue burning indefinitely so long as it is supplied with fuel, friendship was far more fleeting.

Reliquary.json.Name: Foundryman's Observation
Reliquary.json.Description: He knew that, unlike the colors at the heart of the furnace, the outcome of various worldly affairs could not be predicted simply through close observation.

Reliquary.json.Name: Foundryman's Legacy
Reliquary.json.Description: He knew that, unlike the flame at the heart of the furnace, the resolve to pursue a dream could never be simply passed on to those to come after.

Reliquary.json.Name: Foundryman's Conjecture
Reliquary.json.Description: He knew that, unlike the temperature at the heart of the furnace, just how warm or cold a human heart is towards another cannot be clearly measured in degrees.

Reliquary.json.Name: Foundryman's Calculus
Reliquary.json.Description: He knew that, unlike the heat at the heart of the furnace, the workings of power could not be controlled by the simple pull of a lever or the press of a button.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Resolution of Sojourner
Descriptions: Increases Charged Attack CRIT Rate by 30%.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Brave Heart
Descriptions: Increases DMG by 30% against opponents with more than 50% HP.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Defender's Will
Descriptions: DEF +30%
For each different element present in your own party, the wearer's Elemental RES to that corresponding element is increased by 30%.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Tiny Miracle
Descriptions: All Elemental RES increased by 20%.
Incoming elemental DMG increases corresponding Elemental RES by 30% for 10s. Can only occur once every 10s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Berserker
Descriptions: CRIT Rate +12%
When HP is below 70%, CRIT Rate increases by an additional 24%.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Martial Artist
Descriptions: Normal and Charged Attack DMG +15%
After using Elemental Skill, increases Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG by 25% for 8s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Instructor
Descriptions: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80.
Upon triggering an Elemental Reaction, increases all party members' Elemental Mastery by 120 for 8s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Gambler
Descriptions: Increases Elemental Skill DMG by 20%.
Defeating an opponent has a 100% chance to remove Elemental Skill CD. Can only occur once every 15s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: The Exile
Descriptions: Energy Recharge +20%
Using an Elemental Burst regenerates 2 Energy for all party members (excluding the wearer) every 2s for 6s. This effect cannot stack.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Adventurer
Descriptions: Max HP increased by 1,000.
Opening a chest regenerates 30% Max HP over 5s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Lucky Dog
Descriptions: DEF increased by 100.
Picking up Mora restores 300 HP.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Scholar
Descriptions: Energy Recharge +20%
Gaining Elemental Particles or Orbs gives 3 Energy to all party members who have a bow or a catalyst equipped. Can only occur once every 3s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Traveling Doctor
Descriptions: Increases incoming healing by 20%.
Using Elemental Burst restores 20% HP.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Blizzard Strayer
Descriptions: Cryo DMG Bonus +15%
When a character attacks an opponent affected by Cryo, their CRIT Rate is increased by 20%. If the opponent is Frozen, CRIT Rate is increased by an additional 20%.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Thundersoother
Descriptions: Electro RES increased by 40%.
Increases DMG against opponents affected by Electro by 35%.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Lavawalker
Descriptions: Pyro RES increased by 40%.
Increases DMG against opponents affected by Pyro by 35%.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Maiden Beloved
Descriptions: Character Healing Effectiveness +15%
Using an Elemental Skill or Burst increases healing received by all party members by 20% for 10s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Gladiator's Finale
Descriptions: If the wielder of this artifact set uses a Sword, Claymore or Polearm, increases their Normal Attack DMG by 35%.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Viridescent Venerer
Descriptions: Anemo DMG Bonus +15%

Increases Swirl reaction DMG dealt by 60%, and Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by 20%. Decreases opponent's Elemental RES to the element infused in the Swirl by 40% for 10s. Upon triggering a Stellar Swirl in the opponent, will also decrease their Cryo RES by 40%. RES debuffs of the same elemental type do not stack.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Wanderer's Troupe
Descriptions: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80.
Increases Charged Attack DMG by 35% if the character uses a Catalyst or a Bow.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Glacier and Snowfield
Descriptions: Cryo DMG Bonus +15%
Increases Superconduct DMG by 100%. Increases Melt DMG by 15%. Using an Elemental Burst increases Cryo DMG Bonus by 30% for 10s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Thundering Fury
Descriptions: Electro DMG Bonus +15%

Increases the DMG caused by Overloaded, Electro-Charged, Superconduct, and Hyperbloom by 40%, the DMG Bonus conferred by Aggravate by 20%, and the DMG caused by Lunar-Charged and Stellar-Conduct by 20%. When Quicken or the aforementioned Elemental Reactions are triggered, Elemental Skill CD is decreased by 1s. Can only occur once every 0.8s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Crimson Witch of Flames
Descriptions: Pyro DMG Bonus +15%

Increases Overloaded, Burning, and Burgeon DMG by 40%. Increases Vaporize and Melt DMG by 15%. Using Elemental Skill increases the 2-Piece Set Bonus by 50% of its starting value for 10s. Max 3 stacks.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Noblesse Oblige
Descriptions: Elemental Burst DMG +20%
Using an Elemental Burst increases all party members' ATK by 20% for 12s. This effect cannot stack.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Bloodstained Chivalry
Descriptions: Physical DMG +25%
After defeating an opponent, increases Charged Attack DMG by 50%, and reduces its Stamina cost to 0 for 10s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Prayers for Illumination
Descriptions: Affected by Pyro for 40% less time.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Prayers for Destiny
Descriptions: Affected by Hydro for 40% less time.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Prayers for Wisdom
Descriptions: Affected by Electro for 40% less time.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Prayers to the Firmament
Descriptions: Affected by Anemo for 40% less time.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Prayers to Springtime
Descriptions: Affected by Cryo for 40% less time.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Archaic Petra
Descriptions: Gain a 15% Geo DMG Bonus.

Upon obtaining an Elemental Shard created through Crystallize or triggering a Lunar-Crystallize reaction, all party members gain a 35% DMG Bonus for that particular element for 10s. Only one form of Elemental DMG Bonus can be gained in this manner at any one time.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Retracing Bolide
Descriptions: Increases Shield Strength by 35%.
While protected by a shield, gain an additional 40% Normal and Charged Attack DMG.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Heart of Depth
Descriptions: Hydro DMG Bonus +15%
After using Elemental Skill, increases Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG by 30% for 15s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Tenacity of the Millelith
Descriptions: When an Elemental Skill hits an opponent, the ATK of all nearby party members is increased by 20% and their Shield Strength is increased by 30% for 3s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This effect can still be triggered even when the character who is using this artifact set is not on the field.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Pale Flame
Descriptions: Physical DMG is increased by 25%.

When an Elemental Skill hits an opponent, ATK is increased by 9% for 7s. This effect stacks up to 2 times and can be triggered once every 0.3s. Once 2 stacks are reached, the 2-set effect is increased by 100%.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Shimenawa's Reminiscence
Descriptions: When casting an Elemental Skill, if the character has 15 or more Energy, they lose 15 Energy and Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack DMG is increased by 50% for 10s. This effect will not trigger again during that duration.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Emblem of Severed Fate
Descriptions: Energy Recharge +20%
Increases Elemental Burst DMG by 25% of Energy Recharge. A maximum of 75% bonus DMG can be obtained in this way.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Husk of Opulent Dreams
Descriptions: DEF +30%

A character equipped with this Artifact set will obtain the Curiosity effect in the following conditions: When on the field, the character gains 1 stack after hitting an opponent with a Geo attack, triggering a maximum of once every 0.3s. When off the field, the character gains 1 stack every 3s. Curiosity can stack up to 4 times, each providing 6% DEF and a 6% Geo DMG Bonus. When 6 seconds pass without gaining a Curiosity stack, 1 stack is lost.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Ocean-Hued Clam
Descriptions: Healing Bonus +15%.

When the character equipping this artifact set heals a character in the party, a Sea-Dyed Foam will appear for 3 seconds, accumulating the amount of HP recovered from healing (including overflow healing). At the end of the duration, the Sea-Dyed Foam will explode, dealing DMG to nearby opponents based on 90% of the accumulated healing. (This DMG is calculated similarly to Reactions such as Electro-Charged, and Superconduct, but is not affected by Elemental Mastery, Character Levels, or Reaction DMG Bonuses). Only one Sea-Dyed Foam can be produced every 3.5 seconds. Each Sea-Dyed Foam can accumulate up to 30,000 HP (including overflow healing). There can be no more than one Sea-Dyed Foam active at any given time. This effect can still be triggered even when the character who is using this artifact set is not on the field.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Vermillion Hereafter
Descriptions: After using an Elemental Burst, this character will gain the Nascent Light effect, increasing their ATK by 8% for 16s. When the character's HP decreases, their ATK will further increase by 10%. This further increase can occur this way a maximum of 4 times. This effect can be triggered once every 0.8s. Nascent Light will be dispelled when the character leaves the field. If an Elemental Burst is used again during the duration of Nascent Light, the original Nascent Light will be dispelled.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Echoes of an Offering
Descriptions: When Normal Attacks hit opponents, there is a 36% chance that it will trigger Valley Rite, which will increase Normal Attack DMG by 70% of ATK. This effect will be dispelled 0.05s after a Normal Attack deals DMG. If a Normal Attack fails to trigger Valley Rite, the odds of it triggering the next time will increase by 20%. This trigger can occur once every 0.2s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Deepwood Memories
Descriptions: Dendro DMG Bonus +15%.
After Elemental Skills or Bursts hit opponents, the targets' Dendro RES will be decreased by 30% for 8s. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is not on the field.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Gilded Dreams
Descriptions: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80.

Within 8s of triggering an Elemental Reaction, the character equipping this will obtain buffs based on the Elemental Type of the other party members. ATK is increased by 14% for each party member whose Elemental Type is the same as the equipping character, and Elemental Mastery is increased by 50 for every party member with a different Elemental Type. Each of the aforementioned buffs will count up to 3 characters. This effect can be triggered once every 8s. The character who equips this can still trigger its effects when not on the field.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Desert Pavilion Chronicle
Descriptions: Anemo DMG Bonus +15%
When Charged Attacks hit opponents, the equipping character's Normal Attack SPD will increase by 10% while Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG will increase by 40% for 15s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Flower of Paradise Lost
Descriptions: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80.

The equipping character's Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon reaction DMG are increased by 40%, and their Lunar-Bloom reaction DMG is increased by 10%. Additionally, after the equipping character triggers Bloom, Hyperbloom, Lunar-Bloom, or Burgeon, they will gain another 25% bonus to the effects mentioned prior. Each stack of this lasts 10s. Max 4 stacks simultaneously. This effect can only be triggered once per second. The character who equips this can still trigger its effects when not on the field.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Nymph's Dream
Descriptions: Hydro DMG Bonus +15%

After Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts hit opponents, 1 stack of Mirrored Nymph will be triggered, lasting 8s. When under the effect of 1, 2, or 3 or more Mirrored Nymph stacks, ATK will be increased by 7%/16%/25%, and Hydro DMG Bonus will be increased by 4%/9%/15%. Mirrored Nymph stacks created by Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts exist independently.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Vourukasha's Glow
Descriptions: Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG will be increased by 10%. After the equipping character takes DMG, the aforementioned DMG Bonus is increased by 80% for 5s. This effect increase can have 5 stacks. The duration of each stack is counted independently. These effects can be triggered even when the equipping character is not on the field.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Marechaussee Hunter
Descriptions: Normal and Charged Attack DMG +15%
When current HP increases or decreases, CRIT Rate will be increased by 12% for 5s. Max 3 stacks.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Golden Troupe
Descriptions: Increases Elemental Skill DMG by 20%.
Increases Elemental Skill DMG by 25%. Additionally, when not on the field, Elemental Skill DMG will be further increased by 25%. This effect will be cleared 2s after taking the field.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Song of Days Past
Descriptions: Healing Bonus +15%.

When the equipping character heals a party member, the Yearning effect will be created for 6s, which records the total amount of healing provided (including overflow healing). When the duration expires, the Yearning effect will be transformed into the "Waves of Days Past" effect: When your active party member hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst, the DMG dealt will be increased by 8% of the total healing amount recorded by the Yearning effect. The "Waves of Days Past" effect is removed after it has taken effect 5 times or after 10s. A single instance of the Yearning effect can record up to 15,000 healing, and only a single instance can exist at once, but it can record the healing from multiple equipping characters. Equipping characters on standby can still trigger this effect.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods
Descriptions: After using an Elemental Skill, gain a 20% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s. When under a shield granted by the Crystallize reaction, or when Moondrifts formed by Lunar-Crystallize reactions are nearby, the above effect is increased by 150%. When these conditions are no longer met, this additional increase disappears after 1s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy
Descriptions: When the value of a Bond of Life increases or decreases, this character deals 18% increased DMG for 6s. Max 3 stacks.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Unfinished Reverie
Descriptions: After leaving combat for 3s, DMG dealt increased by 50%. In combat, if no Burning opponents are nearby for more than 6s, this DMG Bonus will decrease by 10% per second until it reaches 0%. When a Burning opponent exists, it will increase by 10% instead until it reaches 50%. This effect still triggers if the equipping character is off-field.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City
Descriptions: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, the equipping character regenerates 6 Elemental Energy.

After the equipping character triggers a reaction related to their Elemental Type, all nearby party members gain a 12% Elemental DMG Bonus for the Elemental Types involved in the elemental reaction for 15s. If the equipping character is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state when triggering this effect, all nearby party members gain an additional 28% Elemental DMG Bonus for the Elemental Types involved in the elemental reaction for 20s. The equipping character can trigger this effect while off-field, and the DMG bonus from Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Obsidian Codex
Descriptions: While the equipping character is in Nightsoul's Blessing and is on the field, their DMG dealt is increased by 15%.
After the equipping character consumes 1 Nightsoul point while on the field, CRIT Rate increases by 40% for 6s. This effect can trigger once every second.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Long Night's Oath
Descriptions: Plunging Attack DMG increased by 25%.

After the equipping character's Plunging Attack/Charged Attack/Elemental Skill hits an opponent, they will gain 1/2/2 stack(s) of "Radiance Everlasting." Plunging Attacks, Charged Attacks, or Elemental Skills can each trigger this effect once every 1s. Radiance Everlasting: Plunging Attacks deal 15% increased DMG for 6s. Max 5 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Finale of the Deep Galleries
Descriptions: Cryo DMG Bonus +15%

When the equipping character has 0 Elemental Energy, Normal Attack DMG is increased by 60% and Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 60%. After the equipping character deals Normal Attack DMG, the aforementioned Elemental Burst effect will stop applying for 6s. After the equipping character deals Elemental Burst DMG, the aforementioned Normal Attack effect will stop applying for 6s. This effect can trigger even if the equipping character is off the field.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Night of the Sky's Unveiling
Descriptions: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80.

When nearby party members trigger Lunar Reactions, if the equipping character is on the field, gain the Gleaming Moon: Intent effect for 4s: Increases CRIT Rate by 15%/30% when the party's Moonsign is Nascent Gleam/Ascendant Gleam. All party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is increased by 10% for each different Gleaming Moon effect that party members have. Effects from Gleaming Moon cannot stack.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Silken Moon's Serenade
Descriptions: Energy Recharge +20%.

When dealing Elemental DMG, gain the Gleaming Moon: Devotion effect for 8s: Increases all party members' Elemental Mastery by 60/120 when the party's Moonsign is Nascent Gleam/Ascendant Gleam. The equipping character can trigger this effect while off-field. All party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is increased by 10% for each different Gleaming Moon effect that party members have. Effects from Gleaming Moon cannot stack.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Aubade of Morningstar and Moon
Descriptions: Increases Elemental Mastery by 80.

When the equipping character is off-field, Lunar Reaction DMG is increased by 20%. When the party's Moonsign Level is at least Ascendant Gleam, Lunar Reaction DMG will be further increased by 40%. This effect will disappear after the equipping character is active for 3s.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: A Day Carved From Rising Winds
Descriptions: After a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst hits an opponent, gain the Blessing of Pastoral Winds effect for 6s: ATK is increased by 25%. If the equipping character has completed Witch's Homework, Blessing of Pastoral Winds will be upgraded to Resolve of Pastoral Winds, which additionally increases the CRIT Rate of the equipping character by 20%. This effect can be triggered even when the character is off-field.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Celestial Gift
Descriptions: Energy Recharge +20%.

If the equipping character has completed Witch's Homework, after they use an Elemental Skill, they gain "Light's Guidance" for 20s: All nearby party members gain a 20% Elemental DMG Bonus corresponding to the equipping character's Elemental Type. The equipping character can trigger this effect while off-field. DMG Bonuses provided by Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.
· When your party has the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, Light's Guidance is upgraded to "Mortal Hymn": All nearby party members gain a 40% Elemental DMG Bonus corresponding to both the equipping character and the current active party member's Elemental Type instead. If both characters have the same Elemental Type, these bonuses will not stack.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Disenchantment in Deep Shadow
Descriptions: Increases Superconduct Reaction DMG by 80% and Stellar-Conduct Reaction DMG by 40%. When the wielder attacks opponents affected by Superconduct or Stellar-Conduct, this attack's CRIT Rate is increased by 16%.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Scarlet Proof
Descriptions: Increases the equipping character's CRIT Rate by 16%, and their Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by 40%, for 10s after they trigger a Stellar Swirl reaction.

ReliquarySet.json.Name: Heart of the Furnace
Descriptions: Increases the equipping character's ATK by 12% for 12s when they trigger a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deal Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Also increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members by 50%. The above effects can trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field, and the DMG bonus from multiple Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.
